### Create wallet
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/wallets/create-wallet

> Provisions a new wallet under exactly one provider account: the project's Managed config for provider, or the Custody Connection named by connectionId.

`POST /v1/wallets`

A body naming both, or neither, is rejected with `400`.

With an `Idempotency-Key`, SDP never records a second wallet for one key: a retry returns the wallet an earlier attempt recorded, even after the 24-hour key window. A provider that accepts a request id also receives one derived from the key.

On a provider that dedupes on the request id, a `5xx` is not stored: a same-key retry runs again and gets back the wallet the first attempt made, even when SDP failed to record it, for as long as the provider keeps the request id (permanently, or for 24 hours; the Idempotency guide lists each provider). On any other provider a failure is stored as a `503`, and a new key is a new provider request. A `503` can mean the provider created the wallet before the error. With a provider that accepts no request id, a failure that left no SDP wallet row makes even the same key a new provider request after 24 hours. Before any retry after an ambiguous failure, whatever the key, check `GET /v1/wallets` and, if the wallet is not there, the provider account.

The provider request id and the recorded-wallet lookup both include the credential. After an API key rotation, once the key's 24-hour record has expired, the same key under the new credential is a new provider request and can create a second wallet: list wallets with `GET /v1/wallets` and check the provider account before retrying a create.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `wallets.manage` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string`

  Use a unique 1–255 printable ASCII key per operation. Reuse it with the same request on retries. An in-flight attempt returns `409`; a changed request returns `422`. [Retry and recovery rules](/docs/developing-with-sdp/idempotency).

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Create wallet request body. Names exactly one owner: provider (Managed config) or connectionId (Custody Connection); a body naming both, or neither, is rejected with 400.

Any of:

- **Create a wallet under the project's Managed config for provider.** · must not include `connectionId`

  - **`provider`** · `string` · required · one of `fireblocks`, `privy`, `coinbase_cdp`, `para`, `turnkey`, `dfns`, `ibm_haven`, `anchorage`, `utila` · example `privy`

    Provider whose Managed config owns the new wallet. A project holds one active config per provider.

  - **`label`** · `string` · max length 100 · example `Mint authority wallet`

    Optional label for the new wallet.

  - **`purpose`** · `string` · one of `transfer`, `mint_authority`, `freeze_authority`, `fee_payer` · default `transfer` · example `mint_authority`

    What the wallet is for. Defaults to `transfer`, the only purpose a payment, transfer batch or recurring payment can send from.

- **Create a wallet under a Custody Connection.** · must not include `provider`

  - **`connectionId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cconn_123`

    Custody Connection (BYOK) that owns the new wallet.

  - **`label`** · `string` · max length 100 · example `Mint authority wallet`

    Optional label for the new wallet.

  - **`purpose`** · `string` · one of `transfer`, `mint_authority`, `freeze_authority`, `fee_payer` · default `transfer` · example `mint_authority`

    What the wallet is for. Defaults to `transfer`, the only purpose a payment, transfer batch or recurring payment can send from.

## Responses

- **`201`** Wallet created

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Created wallet response payload.

    - **`wallet`** · `object` · required

      Wallet details.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `cwlt_example`

        Wallet record ID.

      - **`custodyConfigId`** · `string` · example `cfg_example`

        Owning custody configuration ID.

      - **`custodyConnectionId`** · `string` · example `cconn_example`

        Owning Custody Connection ID.

      - **`provider`** · `string` · example `privy`

        Wallet signing provider.

      - **`isRuntimeExecutionAllowed`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

        Whether SDP currently permits attempting runtime execution through this wallet's owner. This is request-time admission, not Provider health or a success guarantee.

      - **`walletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Provider wallet ID.

      - **`publicKey`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Base58-encoded Solana address.

      - **`label`** · `string | null` · required · example `Treasury wallet`

        Optional wallet label.

      - **`purpose`** · `string | null` · required · one of `root`, `mint_authority`, `freeze_authority`, `fee_payer`, `transfer`, `dvp_settlement_authority` · example `transfer`

        Optional wallet purpose.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `inactive` · example `active`

        Wallet status.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`balances`** · `object[]`

        Tracked token balances when requested and successfully observed. Omitted when the balance lookup is unavailable; an empty array is a successful zero-token result.

        - **`token`** · `string` · required · example `USDC`

          Tracked token symbol.

        - **`mint`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `4zMMC9srt5Ri5X14GAgXhaHii3GnPAEERYPJgZJDncDU`

          Tracked token mint address.

        - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `1250000`

          Raw token amount as a string.

        - **`uiAmount`** · `string` · required · example `1.25`

          Human-readable token balance.

        - **`decimals`** · `integer` · required · min 0 · example `6`

          Token decimals.

        - **`usdPrice`** · `number` · example `1`

          Resolved USD price per token when available.

        - **`usdValue`** · `number` · example `125.5`

          Resolved USD value of this balance when pricing is available.

      One of:

      - **Owned by a Managed config.** · must include `custodyConfigId` · must not include `custodyConnectionId`

      - **Owned by a Custody Connection.** · must include `custodyConnectionId` · must not include `custodyConfigId`

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `wallets.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason. Forbidden: the caller lacks the route's action or the API key is wallet-scoped, or the provider account was refused. A refusal's details.reason names the failed check: custody_mode_not_allowed when provider names a Managed config in a Production project (Production is BYOK only: create the wallet in a Custody Connection with connectionId), custody_provider_not_in_release_channel, or provider_not_entitled.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`503`** Service Unavailable

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY=$(uuidgen)
curl -X POST 'https://api.solana.com/v1/wallets' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $IDEMPOTENCY_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "provider": "privy",
    "label": "Treasury wallet",
    "purpose": "transfer"
  }'
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
// Reuse this key when you retry this request.
const idempotencyKey = crypto.randomUUID();
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/wallets", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`,
    "Idempotency-Key": idempotencyKey,
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    "provider": "privy",
    "label": "Treasury wallet",
    "purpose": "transfer"
  })
});
```

```python tab="Python"
import os, requests, uuid

# Reuse this key when you retry this request.
idempotency_key = str(uuid.uuid4())
r = requests.post("https://api.solana.com/v1/wallets",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}", "Idempotency-Key": idempotency_key},
  json={
    "provider": "privy",
    "label": "Treasury wallet",
    "purpose": "transfer"
  })
```

### Delete wallet
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/wallets/delete-wallet

> Deletes the wallet from its exact owning custody target when that Provider supports wallet deletion.

`DELETE /v1/wallets`

Provider, when supplied, is a consistency assertion.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `wallets.execute` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string`

  Use a unique 1–255 printable ASCII key per operation. Reuse it with the same request on retries. An in-flight attempt returns `409`; a changed request returns `422`. [Retry and recovery rules](/docs/developing-with-sdp/idempotency).

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Delete wallet request body.

- **`provider`** · `string` · one of `fireblocks`, `privy`, `coinbase_cdp`, `para`, `turnkey`, `dfns`, `ibm_haven`, `anchorage`, `utila` · example `privy`

  Optional consistency assertion for the Provider of the wallet being deleted.

- **`walletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

  Provider wallet ID to delete from its exact owning target.

## Responses

- **`200`** Wallet deleted

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Delete wallet response payload.

    - **`walletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

      Wallet ID that was deleted.

    - **`deleted`** · `boolean` · required · always `true` · example `true`

      Deletion confirmation flag.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `wallets.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

### List wallet signing configs
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/wallets/list-wallet-configs

> Returns the active Config-owned wallet signing configurations for the requested scope, one per provider.

`GET /v1/wallets/configs`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `wallets.read` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Wallet signing configurations

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Wallet signing configurations response payload.

    - **`configs`** · `object[]` · required

      Active wallet signing configurations for the requested scope.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `cfg_example`

        Wallet signing config ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · example `org_example`

        Organization ID that owns this wallet signing config.

      - **`projectId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Optional project scope for this config.

      - **`provider`** · `string` · required · example `privy`

        Wallet signing provider.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `inactive` · example `active`

        Config status.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `wallets.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `401`.

### Aggregate wallet balances
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/wallets/aggregate-wallet-balances

> Aggregates tracked balances for active wallets under the same owner-aware inclusion rules as the wallet list, without exposing one aggregate-level owner or runtime-admission value.

`GET /v1/wallets/aggregate`

Returns 503 if any included wallet balance cannot be read, rather than returning an incomplete total.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `wallets.read` action.

## Query parameters

- **`provider`** · `string` · one of `fireblocks`, `privy`, `coinbase_cdp`, `para`, `turnkey`, `dfns`, `ibm_haven`, `anchorage`, `utila` · example `privy`

  Wallet signing provider.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Aggregated wallet balances

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Aggregated wallet balance response payload.

    - **`aggregate`** · `object` · required

      Aggregated wallet balance summary.

      - **`walletCount`** · `integer` · required · min 0 · example `3`

        Number of wallets included in the aggregate.

      - **`balances`** · `object[]` · required

        Aggregated tracked token balances across the included wallets.

        - **`token`** · `string` · required · example `USDC`

          Tracked token symbol.

        - **`mint`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `4zMMC9srt5Ri5X14GAgXhaHii3GnPAEERYPJgZJDncDU`

          Tracked token mint address.

        - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `1250000`

          Raw token amount as a string.

        - **`uiAmount`** · `string` · required · example `1.25`

          Human-readable token balance.

        - **`decimals`** · `integer` · required · min 0 · example `6`

          Token decimals.

        - **`usdPrice`** · `number` · example `1`

          Resolved USD price per token when available.

        - **`usdValue`** · `number` · example `125.5`

          Resolved USD value of this balance when pricing is available.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `wallets.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`503`** Service Unavailable

  Same fields as `400`.

### Check signer via simulated memo transaction
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/wallets/check-wallet-signer

> Signs a server-authored memo message with the named wallet, verifies the signature, and simulates the transaction.

`POST /v1/wallets/signer-check`

Nothing is broadcast and no sponsorship is spent. The wallet is the only readonly signer and the request cannot supply memo text.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `wallets.execute` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string`

  Use a unique 1–255 printable ASCII key per operation. Reuse it with the same request on retries. An in-flight attempt returns `409`; a changed request returns `422`. [Retry and recovery rules](/docs/developing-with-sdp/idempotency).

## Request body

`application/json` · required

walletId is the Provider wallet ID to check, required. Ambiguous Provider IDs are rejected; the check uses the resolved exact custody wallet record, and an API key may check only a wallet within its wallet scope.

- **`walletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1

## Responses

- **`200`** Signer check verified in simulation

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Signer check response payload.

    - **`walletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

      Resolved signing wallet ID.

    - **`walletAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Resolved signer address used for the check message.

    - **`feePayer`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Funded fee payer address used in the simulated message; nothing is spent from it.

    - **`memo`** · `string` · required · example `SDP signer check 123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174000`

      Server-generated memo text in the simulated check message.

    - **`signature`** · `string` · required · example `sig_example`

      The custody wallet's Ed25519 signature over the check message, base58. Verified server-side and exercised in RPC simulation only — the check never broadcasts, so this signature does not exist on chain.

    - **`simulated`** · `boolean` · required · always `true`

      Always true: signer checks run in simulation and cannot spend sponsorship.

    - **`checkedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2026-02-20T00:00:00.000Z`

      Timestamp recorded after the simulation succeeded.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `wallets.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`429`** Too Many Requests

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`502`** Bad Gateway

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY=$(uuidgen)
curl -X POST 'https://api.solana.com/v1/wallets/signer-check' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $IDEMPOTENCY_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "walletId": "privy_wallet_123"
  }'
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
// Reuse this key when you retry this request.
const idempotencyKey = crypto.randomUUID();
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/wallets/signer-check", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`,
    "Idempotency-Key": idempotencyKey,
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    "walletId": "privy_wallet_123"
  })
});
```

```python tab="Python"
import os, requests, uuid

# Reuse this key when you retry this request.
idempotency_key = str(uuid.uuid4())
r = requests.post("https://api.solana.com/v1/wallets/signer-check",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}", "Idempotency-Key": idempotency_key},
  json={
    "walletId": "privy_wallet_123"
  })
```

### Get wallet by ID
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/wallets/get-wallet-by-id

> Returns active wallet metadata, exact Config or Connection ownership, runtime execution admission, Provider, public key, and by default the current SOL balance.

`GET /v1/wallets/{walletId}`

If the balance read fails, returns 503 instead of a zero balance. Set includeBalance=false for a metadata-only read.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `wallets.read` action.

## Path parameters

- **`walletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

  Provider wallet ID — the `walletId` field returned by GET /v1/wallets.

## Query parameters

- **`includeBalance`** · `string` · one of `true`, `false` · example `false`

  Whether to resolve the current SOL balance. Defaults to true; false returns metadata without balance RPC or pricing calls.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Wallet details

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Wallet details by ID response payload.

    - **`wallet`** · `object` · required

      Wallet details with provider and optional SOL balance.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `cwlt_example`

        Wallet record ID.

      - **`custodyConfigId`** · `string` · example `cfg_example`

        Owning custody configuration ID.

      - **`custodyConnectionId`** · `string` · example `cconn_example`

        Owning Custody Connection ID.

      - **`provider`** · `string` · required · example `privy`

        Wallet custody provider.

      - **`isRuntimeExecutionAllowed`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

        Whether SDP currently permits attempting runtime execution through this wallet's owner. This is request-time admission, not Provider health or a success guarantee.

      - **`walletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Provider wallet ID.

      - **`publicKey`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Base58-encoded Solana address.

      - **`label`** · `string | null` · required · example `Treasury wallet`

        Optional wallet label.

      - **`purpose`** · `string | null` · required · one of `root`, `mint_authority`, `freeze_authority`, `fee_payer`, `transfer`, `dvp_settlement_authority` · example `transfer`

        Optional wallet purpose.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `inactive` · example `active`

        Wallet status.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`balance`** · `object`

        Current SOL balance for the wallet public key. Omitted when includeBalance=false.

        - **`token`** · `string` · required · always `SOL` · example `SOL`

          Balance token symbol.

        - **`mint`** · `string` · required · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Native SOL mint address.

        - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `123456789`

          Raw lamports balance as a string.

        - **`uiAmount`** · `string` · required · example `0.123456789`

          Human-readable SOL balance.

        - **`decimals`** · `number` · required · always `9` · example `9`

          Token decimals for SOL.

      One of:

      - **Owned by a Managed config.** · must include `custodyConfigId` · must not include `custodyConnectionId`

      - **Owned by a Custody Connection.** · must include `custodyConnectionId` · must not include `custodyConfigId`

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `wallets.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`503`** Service Unavailable

  Same fields as `401`.

### Update wallet
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/wallets/update-wallet

> Updates the display label of an active wallet under its exact Config or Connection owner.

`PATCH /v1/wallets/{walletId}`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `wallets.manage` action.

## Path parameters

- **`walletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

  Provider wallet ID — the `walletId` field returned by GET /v1/wallets.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string`

  Use a unique 1–255 printable ASCII key per operation. Reuse it with the same request on retries. An in-flight attempt returns `409`; a changed request returns `422`. [Retry and recovery rules](/docs/developing-with-sdp/idempotency).

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Update wallet request body.

- **`label`** · `string | null` · max length 100 · example `Treasury signer`

  Optional wallet label. Set to null to clear the label.

## Responses

- **`200`** Wallet updated

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Created wallet response payload.

    - **`wallet`** · `object` · required

      Wallet details.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `cwlt_example`

        Wallet record ID.

      - **`custodyConfigId`** · `string` · example `cfg_example`

        Owning custody configuration ID.

      - **`custodyConnectionId`** · `string` · example `cconn_example`

        Owning Custody Connection ID.

      - **`provider`** · `string` · example `privy`

        Wallet signing provider.

      - **`isRuntimeExecutionAllowed`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

        Whether SDP currently permits attempting runtime execution through this wallet's owner. This is request-time admission, not Provider health or a success guarantee.

      - **`walletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Provider wallet ID.

      - **`publicKey`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Base58-encoded Solana address.

      - **`label`** · `string | null` · required · example `Treasury wallet`

        Optional wallet label.

      - **`purpose`** · `string | null` · required · one of `root`, `mint_authority`, `freeze_authority`, `fee_payer`, `transfer`, `dvp_settlement_authority` · example `transfer`

        Optional wallet purpose.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `inactive` · example `active`

        Wallet status.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`balances`** · `object[]`

        Tracked token balances when requested and successfully observed. Omitted when the balance lookup is unavailable; an empty array is a successful zero-token result.

        - **`token`** · `string` · required · example `USDC`

          Tracked token symbol.

        - **`mint`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `4zMMC9srt5Ri5X14GAgXhaHii3GnPAEERYPJgZJDncDU`

          Tracked token mint address.

        - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `1250000`

          Raw token amount as a string.

        - **`uiAmount`** · `string` · required · example `1.25`

          Human-readable token balance.

        - **`decimals`** · `integer` · required · min 0 · example `6`

          Token decimals.

        - **`usdPrice`** · `number` · example `1`

          Resolved USD price per token when available.

        - **`usdValue`** · `number` · example `125.5`

          Resolved USD value of this balance when pricing is available.

      One of:

      - **Owned by a Managed config.** · must include `custodyConfigId` · must not include `custodyConnectionId`

      - **Owned by a Custody Connection.** · must include `custodyConnectionId` · must not include `custodyConfigId`

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `wallets.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY=$(uuidgen)
curl -X PATCH 'https://api.solana.com/v1/wallets/privy_wallet_123' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $IDEMPOTENCY_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "label": "Treasury signer"
  }'
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
// Reuse this key when you retry this request.

const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/wallets/privy_wallet_123", {
  method: "PATCH",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`,
    "Idempotency-Key": idempotencyKey,
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    "label": "Treasury signer"
  })
});
```

```python tab="Python"

# Reuse this key when you retry this request.
idempotency_key = str(uuid.uuid4())
r = requests.patch("https://api.solana.com/v1/wallets/privy_wallet_123",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}", "Idempotency-Key": idempotency_key},

    "label": "Treasury signer"
  })
```

### Get project provider availability
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/projects/get-project-provider-availability

> Lists every provider this deployment's release channel publishes, with whether this project can use it, counting the deployment's provider credentials for the project's environment.

`GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/provider-availability`

The same rule gates every provider entry point, so a provider reported unavailable is refused there with 403, or 503 when the deployment does not hold its credentials. A project outside the caller's organization, or another project for a project-bound API key, returns 404.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `projects.read` action.

## Path parameters

- **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Project identifier.

## Responses

- **`200`** Project provider availability

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Every provider this deployment's release channel publishes, with whether this project can use it; a provider the channel leaves out is omitted, matching this document. Custody entries list the custody modes the project can set the provider up in (empty when none) in `modes`, and each refused mode with the first failed check in `unavailableModes`; every other entry carries `available`, plus `reason` naming the first failed check when unavailable. A provider is available only when the deployment's release channel includes it, SDP currently offers it, the organization is entitled to it, and the deployment holds its credentials for the project's environment; the release channel offers the same providers to Sandbox and Production projects. Custody `modes` include `managed` only in a Sandbox project whose deployment holds the provider's credentials; `byok` runs on the organization's own credentials and is the only mode a Production project can use.

    - **`projectId`** · `string` · required

    - **`environment`** · `string` · required · one of `sandbox`, `production`

    - **`providers`** · `object[]` · required

      One of:

      - **family: "custody"**

        - **`family`** · `string` · required · always `custody`

        - **`provider`** · `string` · required

        - **`modes`** · `string[]` · required · each one of `managed`, `byok`

        - **`unavailableModes`** · `object[]` · required

          - **`mode`** · `string` · required · one of `managed`, `byok`

          - **`reason`** · `string` · required · one of `custody_provider_not_in_release_channel`, `custody_mode_not_allowed`, `provider_not_entitled`, `provider_not_in_release_channel`, `provider_not_offered`, `provider_not_configured`

      - **family: "compliance"**

        One of:

        - **available: true**

          - **`family`** · `string` · required · always `compliance`

          - **`provider`** · `string` · required · one of `range`, `elliptic`, `trm`, `chainalysis`

          - **`available`** · `boolean` · required · always `true`

        - **available: false**

          - **`family`** · `string` · required · always `compliance`

          - **`provider`** · `string` · required · one of `range`, `elliptic`, `trm`, `chainalysis`

          - **`available`** · `boolean` · required · always `false`

          - **`reason`** · `string` · required · one of `custody_provider_not_in_release_channel`, `custody_mode_not_allowed`, `provider_not_entitled`, `provider_not_in_release_channel`, `provider_not_offered`, `provider_not_configured`

      - **family: "ramps"**

        One of:

        - **available: true**

          - **`family`** · `string` · required · always `ramps`

          - **`provider`** · `string` · required · one of `moonpay`, `stripe`

          - **`available`** · `boolean` · required · always `true`

        - **available: false**

          - **`family`** · `string` · required · always `ramps`

          - **`provider`** · `string` · required · one of `moonpay`, `stripe`

          - **`available`** · `boolean` · required · always `false`

          - **`reason`** · `string` · required · one of `custody_provider_not_in_release_channel`, `custody_mode_not_allowed`, `provider_not_entitled`, `provider_not_in_release_channel`, `provider_not_offered`, `provider_not_configured`

      - **family: "earn"**

        One of:

        - **available: true**

          - **`family`** · `string` · required · always `earn`

          - **`provider`** · `string` · required · one of `veda`, `upshift`, `perena`, `kamino`, `jupiter_lend`, `ondo`, `hastra`, `wisdomtree`, `plume`

          - **`available`** · `boolean` · required · always `true`

        - **available: false**

          - **`family`** · `string` · required · always `earn`

          - **`provider`** · `string` · required · one of `veda`, `upshift`, `perena`, `kamino`, `jupiter_lend`, `ondo`, `hastra`, `wisdomtree`, `plume`

          - **`available`** · `boolean` · required · always `false`

          - **`reason`** · `string` · required · one of `custody_provider_not_in_release_channel`, `custody_mode_not_allowed`, `provider_not_entitled`, `provider_not_in_release_channel`, `provider_not_offered`, `provider_not_configured`

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `projects.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `401`.

```json tab="200"
          },
          {
            "mode": "byok",
            "reason": "custody_provider_not_in_release_channel"
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "family": "compliance",
        "provider": "range",
        "available": true
      },
      {
        "family": "ramps",
        "provider": "moonpay",
        "available": false,
        "reason": "provider_not_entitled"
      },
      {
        "family": "earn",
        "provider": "kamino",
        "available": false,
        "reason": "provider_not_entitled"
      }
    ]
  },
  "meta": {
    "requestId": "req_example",
    "timestamp": "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

```json tab="403"
  "error": {
    "code": "INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS",

    "details": {
      "action": "projects.read"
```

### List project integrations
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/projects/list-project-integrations

> Lists the project's integrations and how each reaches the project.

`GET /v1/integrations`

A provider is listed only when the project can use it, decided by the same rule that admits its use, so an integration listed here is never refused for availability at its entry point. The project comes from the `x-project-id` header, or from the API key's own project.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `projects.read` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Project integrations

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    The project's integrations, grouped by family in a fixed order. A family this deployment does not run, or with no provider the project can use, is omitted. Each integration's `state` is `not_configured` (the project can set it up, in the listed `modes`), `provided` (SDP supplies it and the project sets nothing up), or `connected` (the project's own setup is active; `mode` says whether it runs on the deployment's provider account, `managed`, or the project's own, `byok`).

    - **`projectId`** · `string` · required

    - **`environment`** · `string` · required · one of `sandbox`, `production`

    - **`families`** · `object[]` · required

      One of:

      - **family: "custody"**

        - **`family`** · `string` · required · always `custody`

        - **`integrations`** · `object[]` · required · min items 1

          - **`provider`** · `string` · required

          - **`category`** · `string` · required · one of `server`, `institutional`

          - **`state`** · `object` · required

            One of:

            - **status: "not_configured"**

              - **`status`** · `string` · required · always `not_configured`

              - **`modes`** · `string[]` · required · min items 1 · each one of `managed`, `byok`

            - **status: "provided"**

              - **`status`** · `string` · required · always `provided`

              - **`modes`** · `string[]` · required · each one of `managed`, `byok`

            - **status: "connected"**

              - **`status`** · `string` · required · always `connected`

              - **`mode`** · `string` · required · one of `managed`, `byok`

      - **family: "rpc"**

        - **`family`** · `string` · required · always `rpc`

        - **`integrations`** · `object[]` · required · min items 1

          - **`provider`** · `string` · required · one of `alchemy`, `helius`, `nodit`, `quicknode`, `triton`, `validationcloud`

          - **`state`** · `object` · required

            One of:

            - **status: "not_configured"**

              - **`status`** · `string` · required · always `not_configured`

              - **`modes`** · `string[]` · required · min items 1 · each one of `managed`, `byok`

            - **status: "provided"**

              - **`status`** · `string` · required · always `provided`

              - **`modes`** · `string[]` · required · each one of `managed`, `byok`

            - **status: "connected"**

              - **`status`** · `string` · required · always `connected`

              - **`mode`** · `string` · required · one of `managed`, `byok`

      - **family: "ramps"**

        - **`family`** · `string` · required · always `ramps`

        - **`integrations`** · `object[]` · required · min items 1

          - **`provider`** · `string` · required · one of `moonpay`, `stripe`

          - **`state`** · `object` · required

            One of:

            - **status: "not_configured"**

              - **`status`** · `string` · required · always `not_configured`

              - **`modes`** · `string[]` · required · min items 1 · each one of `managed`, `byok`

            - **status: "provided"**

              - **`status`** · `string` · required · always `provided`

              - **`modes`** · `string[]` · required · each one of `managed`, `byok`

            - **status: "connected"**

              - **`status`** · `string` · required · always `connected`

              - **`mode`** · `string` · required · one of `managed`, `byok`

      - **family: "compliance"**

        - **`family`** · `string` · required · always `compliance`

        - **`integrations`** · `object[]` · required · min items 1

          - **`provider`** · `string` · required · one of `range`, `elliptic`, `trm`, `chainalysis`

          - **`state`** · `object` · required

            One of:

            - **status: "not_configured"**

              - **`status`** · `string` · required · always `not_configured`

              - **`modes`** · `string[]` · required · min items 1 · each one of `managed`, `byok`

            - **status: "provided"**

              - **`status`** · `string` · required · always `provided`

              - **`modes`** · `string[]` · required · each one of `managed`, `byok`

            - **status: "connected"**

              - **`status`** · `string` · required · always `connected`

              - **`mode`** · `string` · required · one of `managed`, `byok`

      - **family: "private_channels"**

        - **`family`** · `string` · required · always `private_channels`

        - **`integrations`** · `object[]` · required · min items 1

          - **`provider`** · `string` · required · always `private_channels`

          - **`state`** · `object` · required

            One of:

            - **status: "not_configured"**

              - **`status`** · `string` · required · always `not_configured`

              - **`modes`** · `string[]` · required · min items 1 · each one of `managed`, `byok`

            - **status: "provided"**

              - **`status`** · `string` · required · always `provided`

              - **`modes`** · `string[]` · required · each one of `managed`, `byok`

            - **status: "connected"**

              - **`status`** · `string` · required · always `connected`

              - **`mode`** · `string` · required · one of `managed`, `byok`

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `projects.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`503`** Service Unavailable

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl 'https://api.solana.com/v1/integrations' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/integrations", {

```

```python tab="Python"
import os, requests

  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}"})
```

## Issuance: Templates

### List token templates
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/issuance/list-token-templates

> Returns all available token templates with their default configuration and supported extensions.

`GET /v1/issuance/templates`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.read` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Template list

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    List templates response payload.

    - **`templates`** · `object[]` · required

      List of available token templates.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · one of `stablecoin`, `arcade`, `tokenized-security`, `custom`, `rwa` · example `stablecoin`

        Token template identifier.

      - **`name`** · `string` · required · example `Stablecoin`

        Human-readable template name.

      - **`description`** · `string` · example `USD-backed stablecoins with compliance controls and privacy features`

        Template description and use case.

      - **`decimals`** · `integer` · required · example `6`

        Default decimals for the template.

      - **`maxDecimals`** · `integer` · required · example `18`

        Maximum allowed decimals for this template.

      - **`requiresAllowlist`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

        Whether allowlists are required for this template by default.

      - **`allowlistOverridable`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

        Whether allowlist enforcement can be disabled by request.

      - **`requiredExtensions`** · `string[]` · required · each one of `transferFee`, `interestBearing`, `permanentDelegate`, `pausable`, `nonTransferable`, `defaultAccountState`, `scaledUiAmount`, `transferHook` · each example `transferFee`

        Required Token-2022 extensions for this template.

      - **`availableExtensions`** · `string[]` · required · each one of `transferFee`, `interestBearing`, `permanentDelegate`, `pausable`, `nonTransferable`, `defaultAccountState`, `scaledUiAmount`, `transferHook` · each example `transferFee`

        Extensions that can be configured for this template.

      - **`defaultExtensions`** · `object` · required

        Default extension values used by this template.

        - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `401`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"

  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY"
```

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl 'https://api.solana.com/v1/issuance/templates/stablecoin' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/issuance/templates/stablecoin", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`
  }
});
```

```python tab="Python"
import os, requests

r = requests.get("https://api.solana.com/v1/issuance/templates/stablecoin",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}"})
```

```json tab="200"
  "data": {
    "template": {

      "maxDecimals": 18,
      "requiresAllowlist": true,
      "allowlistOverridable": true,

        "permanentDelegate",
        "pausable"
      ],

        "scaledUiAmount",
        "interestBearing"
      ],
      "defaultExtensions": {
        "defaultAccountState": "initialized"
      }
    }
  },

    "requestId": "req_example",
    "timestamp": "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"
  }

```

```json tab="403"
    "code": "INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS",
```

## Issuance: Tokens

### Create token
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/issuance/create-token

> Creates a token record that can later be deployed to Solana.

`POST /v1/issuance/tokens`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.manage` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Create token request body.

- **`name`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · max length 100 · example `Example Token`

  Token name.

- **`symbol`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · max length 10 · pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9]+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9]+)*$` · example `EXM`

  Ticker symbol.

- **`signingCustodyWalletId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

  Optional exact SDP Wallet ID for direct deployment. A draft may defer selection until deploy.

- **`decimals`** · `integer` · min 0 · max 18 · example `6`

  Token decimals.

- **`description`** · `string` · max length 500 · example `Example token description.`

  Token description.

- **`uri`** · `string` · format `uri` · max length 512 · example `https://example.com/metadata.json`

  Metadata URI passed to on-chain token metadata (points to off-chain JSON).

- **`imageUrl`** · `string` · format `uri` · max length 512 · example `https://example.com/token.png`

  Token image URL.

- **`maxSupply`** · `string` · example `1000000`

  Maximum supply as a string (UI units).

- **`template`** · `string` · one of `stablecoin`, `arcade`, `tokenized-security`, `custom` · example `stablecoin`

  Token template preset. Defaults to 'custom' if not specified.

- **`overrides`** · `object`

  Template overrides to customize defaults.

  - **`extensions`** · `object`

    Override template extension configuration.

    - **`transferFee`** · `boolean | object`

      Transfer fee configuration or false to disable.

      Any of:

      - **boolean** · always `false`

      - **object**

        - **`basisPoints`** · `integer` · required · min 0 · max 10000 · example `50`

          Transfer fee in basis points.

        - **`maxFee`** · `string` · required · example `0.5`

          Maximum fee in UI units.

        - **`transferFeeConfigAuthority`** · `string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority to configure transfer fees. Defaults to platform authority.

        - **`withdrawWithheldAuthority`** · `string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority to withdraw withheld fees. Defaults to platform authority.

    - **`interestBearing`** · `boolean | object`

      Interest-bearing configuration or false to disable.

      Any of:

      - **boolean** · always `false`

      - **object**

        - **`rate`** · `number` · required · example `2.5`

          Interest rate in percent.

        - **`rateAuthority`** · `string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority that can update the rate. Defaults to platform authority.

    - **`permanentDelegate`** · `boolean | string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Permanent delegate authority address, or false to disable.

      Any of:

      - **boolean** · always `false`

      - **string**

    - **`pausable`** · `boolean | object`

      Pausable configuration or false to disable.

      Any of:

      - **boolean** · always `false`

      - **object**

        - **`authority`** · `string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority that can pause/resume transfers. Defaults to platform authority.

    - **`nonTransferable`** · `boolean` · example `false`

      Enable/disable non-transferable.

    - **`defaultAccountState`** · `string` · one of `initialized`, `frozen` · example `frozen`

      Override default account state.

    - **`scaledUiAmount`** · `boolean | object`

      Scaled UI amount configuration or false to disable.

      Any of:

      - **boolean** · always `false`

      - **object**

        - **`authority`** · `string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority that can update scaled UI parameters. Defaults to platform authority.

        - **`multiplier`** · `number` · required · example `1`

          Current UI multiplier.

        - **`newMultiplier`** · `number` · example `2`

          Scheduled multiplier.

        - **`newMultiplierEffectiveTimestamp`** · `integer` · example `1735689600`

          Unix timestamp (seconds) when the new multiplier takes effect.

    - **`transferHook`** · `boolean | object`

      Transfer hook configuration or false to disable.

      Any of:

      - **boolean** · always `false`

      - **object**

        - **`programId`** · `string` · required · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Transfer hook program id.

        - **`authority`** · `string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority that can update the hook program. Defaults to platform authority.

  - **`requiresAllowlist`** · `boolean` · example `true`

    Override allowlist requirement (if template allows).

- **`requiresAllowlist`** · `boolean` · example `true`

  Require allowlist checks for transfers.

- **`isMintable`** · `boolean` · example `true`

  Allow minting after creation.

- **`isFreezable`** · `boolean` · example `true`

  Allow freezing token accounts.

## Responses

- **`201`** Token created

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Token response payload.

    - **`token`** · `object` · required

      Token details.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

        Token identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`signingCustodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

        Exact deployment wallet selected for a pending token, or historical deployment attribution after deployment. This is not the current signer for later authority operations.

      - **`mintAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Mint address once deployed.

      - **`mintAuthority`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Mint authority address, if set.

      - **`freezeAuthority`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Freeze authority address, if set.

      - **`ablListAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain allowlist/blocklist address, if enabled.

      - **`name`** · `string` · required · example `Example Token`

        Token name.

      - **`symbol`** · `string` · required · example `EXM`

        Token symbol.

      - **`decimals`** · `integer` · required · example `9`

        Token decimals.

      - **`description`** · `string | null` · required · example `Example token description.`

        Token description.

      - **`uri`** · `string | null` · required · example `https://example.com/metadata.json`

        Metadata URI passed to on-chain token metadata (points to off-chain JSON).

      - **`imageUrl`** · `string | null` · required · example `https://example.com/token.png`

        Token image URL.

      - **`template`** · `string` · required · one of `stablecoin`, `arcade`, `tokenized-security`, `custom`, `rwa` · example `stablecoin`

        Token template identifier.

      - **`extensions`** · `object | null` · required

        Token-2022 extensions configuration.

        - **`transferFee`** · `object`

          Transfer fee configuration.

          - **`basisPoints`** · `integer` · required · min 0 · max 10000 · example `25`

            Transfer fee in basis points (0-10000).

          - **`maxFee`** · `string` · required · example `0.5`

            Maximum fee in UI units.

          - **`transferFeeConfigAuthority`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority to configure transfer fees.

          - **`withdrawWithheldAuthority`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority to withdraw withheld fees.

        - **`interestBearing`** · `object`

          Interest-bearing configuration.

          - **`rate`** · `number` · required · example `2.5`

            Interest rate in percent.

          - **`rateAuthority`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can update the rate.

        - **`permanentDelegate`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Permanent delegate address.

        - **`pausable`** · `object`

          Pausable configuration.

          - **`authority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can pause/resume transfers.

        - **`nonTransferable`** · `boolean` · example `false`

          Mark token as non-transferable.

        - **`defaultAccountState`** · `string` · one of `initialized`, `frozen` · example `initialized`

          Default account state.

        - **`scaledUiAmount`** · `object`

          Scaled UI amount configuration.

          - **`authority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can update scaled UI parameters.

          - **`multiplier`** · `number` · required · example `1`

            Current UI multiplier.

          - **`newMultiplier`** · `number` · required · example `2`

            Scheduled multiplier.

          - **`newMultiplierEffectiveTimestamp`** · `integer` · required · example `1735689600`

            Unix timestamp (seconds) when the new multiplier takes effect.

        - **`transferHook`** · `object`

          Transfer hook configuration.

          - **`programId`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Transfer hook program id.

          - **`authority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can update the transfer hook program.

      - **`totalSupply`** · `string` · required · example `1000000`

        Cached total supply in UI units (stored to avoid frequent RPC reads). Use POST /v1/issuance/tokens/\{tokenId\}/supply/refresh to force an on-chain refresh.

      - **`totalSupplyUpdatedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `null`

        Timestamp when supply was last refreshed.

      - **`maxSupply`** · `string | null` · required · example `10000000`

        Maximum supply in UI units, if capped.

      - **`isMintable`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

        Whether additional minting is allowed.

      - **`isFreezable`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

        Whether freeze authority is enabled.

      - **`requiresAllowlist`** · `boolean` · required · example `false`

        Whether transfers require allowlist approval.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `active`, `paused`, `revoked` · example `active`

        Token lifecycle status.

      - **`deployedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-05T00:00:00.000Z`

        Deployment timestamp, if deployed.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string` · required · example `key_example`

        Actor identifier that created the token.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

    - **`allowlistAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Live on-chain list authority. Returned only by GET token with includeAllowlistAuthority=true; null when no on-chain list is configured. This is not the token freeze authority or a signer authorization.

    - **`freezeAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Live freeze-operation authority. Returned only by GET token with includeFreezeAuthority=true. For Token ACL mints this is the mint-config controller rather than the mint's program PDA freeze authority.

    - **`metadataAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Metadata authority, returned only by GET token with includeMetadataAuthority=true. Read live on-chain when the token has a mint; otherwise the stored metadata authority or stored mint authority. Null when unavailable. RPC failure returns 502 without falling back to stored authority. This read does not authorize signing or change the token.

    - **`pauseAuthority`** · `string | null` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Live on-chain pausable authority. Returned only by GET token with includePauseAuthority=true; null when the mint has no pausable authority.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl -X POST 'https://api.solana.com/v1/issuance/tokens' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Example Token",
    "symbol": "EXM",
    "signingCustodyWalletId": "cwlt_example",
    "decimals": 6,
    "description": "Example token description.",
    "uri": "https://example.com/metadata.json",
    "imageUrl": "https://example.com/token.png",
    "maxSupply": "1000000",
    "template": "stablecoin",
    "overrides": {
      "extensions": {
        "transferFee": {
          "basisPoints": 50,
          "maxFee": "0.5"
        }
      }
    },
    "requiresAllowlist": true,
    "isMintable": true,
    "isFreezable": true
  }'
```
