### Prepare subscription plan creation
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/prepare-payment-subscription-plan-create

> Prepares an unsigned Solana subscriptions program create-plan transaction from an SDP subscription plan.

`POST /v1/payments/subscription-plans/{planId}/prepare-create`

This derives and stores the plan PDA but does not submit the transaction.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.manage` action.

## Path parameters

- **`planId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `psp_example`

  SDP subscription plan record ID.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Request body

`application/json`

Optional overrides used when preparing the Solana subscriptions create-plan transaction.

- **`destinations`** · `string[]` · max items 4

  Allowed destination addresses for the on-chain plan. Defaults to the stored plan destination.

- **`pullers`** · `string[]` · max items 4

  Allowed puller addresses for the on-chain plan. Defaults to the stored puller or owner address.

- **`endTs`** · `string` · pattern `^\d+$` · example `1770000000`

  Optional unsigned 64-bit Unix timestamp when the on-chain plan ends.

- **`metadataUri`** · `string` · format `uri` · max length 128 · example `https://example.com/subscriptions/monthly-usdc.json`

  Optional metadata URI to embed in the on-chain plan.

## Responses

- **`200`** Subscription plan creation prepared

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Prepared Solana subscriptions create-plan response payload.

    - **`subscriptionPlan`** · `object` · required

      Recurring payment subscription plan record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `psp_example`

        SDP subscription plan ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`ownerWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Provider wallet ID — the `walletId` field returned by GET /v1/wallets.

      - **`ownerAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Base58-encoded Solana address.

      - **`token`** · `string` · required

        Token mint or normalized token identifier.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`periodHours`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `720`

      - **`programPlanId`** · `string` · required · example `17014118346046923173`

        Unsigned 64-bit decimal program plan identifier used in PDA derivation.

      - **`planPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain plan PDA.

      - **`destinationAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Allowed destination owner address.

      - **`pullerWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Collector wallet ID.

      - **`pullerAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Collector wallet address.

      - **`metadataUri`** · `string | null` · required

        Optional plan metadata URI.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `draft`, `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Subscription plan status.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required

        Creator user ID or API key ID.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`planPda`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Derived Solana subscriptions plan PDA.

    - **`preparedTransaction`** · `object` · required

      Unsigned Solana subscriptions transaction payload for client-side signing.

      - **`serialized`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `AQID`

        Base64-encoded unsigned transaction.

      - **`blockhash`** · `string` · required · example `blockhash_example`

        Blockhash for the transaction.

      - **`lastValidBlockHeight`** · `string` · required · example `123456`

        Last valid block height.

      - **`requiredSigners`** · `string[]` · required · each min length 32 · each max length 44 · each example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Addresses that must sign the prepared transaction. This includes the sponsored fee payer when the transaction uses one.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `recurring.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`503`** Service Unavailable

  Same fields as `400`.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `recurring.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `401`.

### Update subscription plan
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/update-payment-subscription-plan

> Updates mutable subscription plan fields and on-chain identifiers.

`PATCH /v1/payments/subscription-plans/{planId}`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`planId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `psp_example`

  SDP subscription plan record ID.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string`

  Use a unique 1–255 printable ASCII key per operation. Reuse it with the same request on retries. An in-flight attempt returns `409`; a changed request returns `422`. [Retry and recovery rules](/docs/developing-with-sdp/idempotency).

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Updates mutable SDP subscription plan fields.

- **`planPda`** · `string | null` · example `7xKXtg2CW87d97TXJSDpbD5jBkheTqA83TZRuJosgAsU`

  On-chain plan PDA, or null to clear it.

- **`destinationAddress`** · `string | null`

  Destination owner address, or null to clear it.

- **`pullerWalletId`** · `string | null` · min length 1 · example `wal_collector`

  Collection wallet ID, or null to clear it.

- **`metadataUri`** · `string | null` · format `uri` · max length 128

  Plan metadata URI, or null to clear it.

- **`status`** · `string` · one of `draft`, `active`, `archived` · example `active`

  Subscription plan status.

## Responses

- **`200`** Subscription plan updated

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Subscription plan response payload.

    - **`subscriptionPlan`** · `object` · required

      Recurring payment subscription plan record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `psp_example`

        SDP subscription plan ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`ownerWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Provider wallet ID — the `walletId` field returned by GET /v1/wallets.

      - **`ownerAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Base58-encoded Solana address.

      - **`token`** · `string` · required

        Token mint or normalized token identifier.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`periodHours`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `720`

      - **`programPlanId`** · `string` · required · example `17014118346046923173`

        Unsigned 64-bit decimal program plan identifier used in PDA derivation.

      - **`planPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain plan PDA.

      - **`destinationAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Allowed destination owner address.

      - **`pullerWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `privy_wallet_123`

        Collector wallet ID.

      - **`pullerAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Collector wallet address.

      - **`metadataUri`** · `string | null` · required

        Optional plan metadata URI.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `draft`, `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Subscription plan status.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required

        Creator user ID or API key ID.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `recurring.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

## Payments: Subscriptions

### Create subscription
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/create-payment-subscription

> Creates a recurring-payment subscription record tied to a counterparty.

`POST /v1/payments/subscriptions`

The customer must still sign the Solana subscription authorization transaction. The subscriber must be the customer's own wallet: a subscriber that is one of the organization's SDP wallets answers 409, because to pay on a schedule from an SDP wallet you create a recurring payment, which keeps the wallet's token approval bounded.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.manage` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string`

  Use a unique 1–255 printable ASCII key per operation. Reuse it with the same request on retries. An in-flight attempt returns `409`; a changed request returns `422`. [Retry and recovery rules](/docs/developing-with-sdp/idempotency).

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Creates a pending SDP subscription record tied to a counterparty. Lifecycle, schedule, on-chain addresses, and authorization proof are server-owned and populated only by verified flows.

- **`planId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `psp_example`

  SDP subscription plan ID.

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  Counterparty being billed for the recurring payment.

- **`subscriberAddress`** · `string` · required · example `7xKXtg2CW87d97TXJSDpbD5jBkheTqA83TZRuJosgAsU`

  Customer wallet address that authorizes the subscription.

## Responses

- **`201`** Subscription created

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Subscription response payload.

    - **`subscription`** · `object` · required

      Recurring payment subscription record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `psub_example`

        SDP subscription ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`planId`** · `string` · required

        SDP subscription plan ID.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required

        Counterparty ID.

      - **`subscriberAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Base58-encoded Solana address.

      - **`subscriberTokenAccount`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Subscriber token account address.

      - **`subscriptionPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription PDA.

      - **`subscriptionAuthorityAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription authority address.

      - **`authorizationSignature`** · `string | null` · required

        Customer authorization transaction signature.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending_authorization`, `active`, `paused`, `canceling`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `active`

        Subscription status.

      - **`currentPeriodStartAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`nextCollectionDueAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`cancelAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`canceledAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `recurring.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `recurring.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request


### Prepare subscription authorization
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/prepare-payment-subscription-authorization

> Prepares the subscriber-signed Solana transaction that initializes the subscription authority and subscribes to the plan.

`POST /v1/payments/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/prepare-authorization`

The transaction must still be signed and submitted by the client. A subscriber that is one of the organization's SDP wallets answers 409: pay from an SDP wallet through a recurring payment.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`subscriptionId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `psub_example`

  SDP subscription record ID.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Inputs for preparing the subscriber-signed Solana subscription authorization transaction.

- **`subscriberTokenAccount`** · `string` · required · example `7xKXtg2CW87d97TXJSDpbD5jBkheTqA83TZRuJosgAsU`

  Subscriber token account that authorizes the subscription authority delegation.

- **`expectedPlanCreatedAt`** · `string` · required · pattern `^\d+$` · example `0`

  Unsigned 64-bit created-at timestamp from the on-chain plan terms that the subscriber consents to.

- **`expectedSubscriptionAuthorityInitId`** · `string` · required · pattern `^-?\d+$` · example `0`

  Signed 64-bit init id from the on-chain subscription authority that the subscriber consents to.

## Responses

- **`200`** Subscription authorization prepared

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Prepared subscription authorization response payload.

    - **`subscription`** · `object` · required

      Recurring payment subscription record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `psub_example`

        SDP subscription ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`planId`** · `string` · required

        SDP subscription plan ID.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required

        Counterparty ID.

      - **`subscriberAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Base58-encoded Solana address.

      - **`subscriberTokenAccount`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Subscriber token account address.

      - **`subscriptionPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription PDA.

      - **`subscriptionAuthorityAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription authority address.

      - **`authorizationSignature`** · `string | null` · required

        Customer authorization transaction signature.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending_authorization`, `active`, `paused`, `canceling`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `active`

        Subscription status.

      - **`currentPeriodStartAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`nextCollectionDueAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`cancelAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`canceledAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`subscriptionPda`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Derived subscription delegation PDA.

    - **`subscriptionAuthorityAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Derived subscription authority PDA.

    - **`preparedTransaction`** · `object` · required

      Unsigned Solana subscriptions transaction payload for client-side signing.

      - **`serialized`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `AQID`

        Base64-encoded unsigned transaction.

      - **`blockhash`** · `string` · required · example `blockhash_example`

        Blockhash for the transaction.

      - **`lastValidBlockHeight`** · `string` · required · example `123456`

        Last valid block height.

      - **`requiredSigners`** · `string[]` · required · each min length 32 · each max length 44 · each example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Addresses that must sign the prepared transaction. This includes the sponsored fee payer when the transaction uses one.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `recurring.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`503`** Service Unavailable

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"

  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \

  -d '{
    "subscriberTokenAccount": "7xKXtg2CW87d97TXJSDpbD5jBkheTqA83TZRuJosgAsU",

```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
  },

  })
});
```

### Prepare subscription resume
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/prepare-payment-subscription-resume

      - **`lastValidBlockHeight`** · `string` · required · example `123456`

        Last valid block height.

      - **`requiredSigners`** · `string[]` · required · each min length 32 · each max length 44 · each example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Addresses that must sign the prepared transaction. This includes the sponsored fee payer when the transaction uses one.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `recurring.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`503`** Service Unavailable

  Same fields as `400`.

### Prepare subscription collection
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/prepare-payment-subscription-collection

> Prepares the collector-signed Solana subscriptions transfer transaction for an active subscription.

`POST /v1/payments/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/prepare-collection`

The transaction must still be signed and submitted by the collector/fee-payer flow. A subscription that belongs to a recurring payment, or whose subscriber is one of the organization's SDP wallets, answers 409: SDP collects from an SDP wallet only through a recurring payment.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`subscriptionId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `psub_example`

  SDP subscription record ID.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Inputs for preparing the collector-signed Solana subscriptions transfer transaction. The amount is always derived from the stored plan.

- **`receiverTokenAccount`** · `string` · required · example `7xKXtg2CW87d97TXJSDpbD5jBkheTqA83TZRuJosgAsU`

  Receiver token account for the pulled subscription payment. It must be allowed by the on-chain plan.

## Responses

- **`200`** Subscription collection prepared

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Prepared subscription collection response payload.

    - **`subscription`** · `object` · required

      Recurring payment subscription record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `psub_example`

        SDP subscription ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`planId`** · `string` · required

        SDP subscription plan ID.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required

        Counterparty ID.

      - **`subscriberAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Base58-encoded Solana address.

      - **`subscriberTokenAccount`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Subscriber token account address.

      - **`subscriptionPda`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription PDA.

      - **`subscriptionAuthorityAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain subscription authority address.

      - **`authorizationSignature`** · `string | null` · required

        Customer authorization transaction signature.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending_authorization`, `active`, `paused`, `canceling`, `canceled`, `expired` · example `active`

        Subscription status.

      - **`currentPeriodStartAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`nextCollectionDueAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`cancelAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`canceledAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`preparedTransaction`** · `object` · required

      Unsigned Solana subscriptions transaction payload for client-side signing.

      - **`serialized`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `AQID`

        Base64-encoded unsigned transaction.

      - **`blockhash`** · `string` · required · example `blockhash_example`

        Blockhash for the transaction.

      - **`lastValidBlockHeight`** · `string` · required · example `123456`

        Last valid block height.

      - **`requiredSigners`** · `string[]` · required · each min length 32 · each max length 44 · each example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Addresses that must sign the prepared transaction. This includes the sponsored fee payer when the transaction uses one.

    - **`collectionAttempt`** · `object`

      Recurring payment collection attempt record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `psca_example`

        Collection attempt ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`subscriptionId`** · `string` · required

        Subscription ID.

      - **`transferId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `xfr_example`

        Payment transfer record ID when linked.

      - **`token`** · `string` · required

        Token mint or normalized token identifier.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`dueAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`attemptedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `failed`, `skipped` · example `pending`

        Collection attempt status.

      - **`signature`** · `string | null` · required

        Solana transaction signature.

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required · example `The wallet used for this payment does not have enough funds. Add funds and try again.`

        Why the collection failed, if it did. A source wallet that cannot cover the amount records the same text the collect request returned with `400 TRANSACTION_FAILED`.

      - **`metadata`** · `object` · required

        Provider/job metadata for the attempt.

        One of:

        - **source: "manual"**

          - **`recurringPaymentId`** · `string` · required

          - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`source`** · `string` · required · always `manual`

        - **source: "automated"**

          - **`recurringPaymentId`** · `string` · required

          - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`source`** · `string` · required · always `automated`

        - **source: "retry"**

          - **`recurringPaymentId`** · `string` · required

          - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`source`** · `string` · required · always `retry`

          - **`initialSource`** · `string` · required · one of `manual`, `automated`

          - **`transferId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`error`** · `string` · required

          - **`retryAfterAt`** · `string` · required

        - **source: "linked_transfer"**

          - **`recurringPaymentId`** · `string` · required

          - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`source`** · `string` · required · always `linked_transfer`

          - **`initialSource`** · `string` · required · one of `manual`, `automated`

          - **`transferId`** · `string` · required

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `recurring.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`503`** Service Unavailable

  Same fields as `400`.

### List subscription collection attempts
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/list-payment-subscription-collection-attempts

> Lists collection attempts for a recurring-payment subscription.

`GET /v1/payments/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/collection-attempts`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `recurring.read` action.

## Path parameters

- **`subscriptionId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `psub_example`

  SDP subscription record ID.

## Query parameters

- **`status`** · `string` · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `failed`, `skipped` · example `pending`

  Collection attempt status.

- **`page`** · `integer` · greater than 0 · default `1`

- **`pageSize`** · `integer` · min 1 · max 100 · default `20`

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Collection attempt list

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Collection attempt list response payload.

    - **`collectionAttempts`** · `object[]` · required

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `psca_example`

        Collection attempt ID.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`subscriptionId`** · `string` · required

        Subscription ID.

      - **`transferId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `xfr_example`

        Payment transfer record ID when linked.

      - **`token`** · `string` · required

        Token mint or normalized token identifier.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

        Token amount in UI units (decimal string).

      - **`dueAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`attemptedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `processing`, `confirmed`, `failed`, `skipped` · example `pending`

        Collection attempt status.

      - **`signature`** · `string | null` · required

        Solana transaction signature.

      - **`error`** · `string | null` · required · example `The wallet used for this payment does not have enough funds. Add funds and try again.`

        Why the collection failed, if it did. A source wallet that cannot cover the amount records the same text the collect request returned with `400 TRANSACTION_FAILED`.

      - **`metadata`** · `object` · required

        Provider/job metadata for the attempt.

        One of:

        - **source: "manual"**

          - **`recurringPaymentId`** · `string` · required

          - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`source`** · `string` · required · always `manual`

        - **source: "automated"**

          - **`recurringPaymentId`** · `string` · required

          - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`source`** · `string` · required · always `automated`

        - **source: "retry"**

          - **`recurringPaymentId`** · `string` · required

          - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`source`** · `string` · required · always `retry`

          - **`initialSource`** · `string` · required · one of `manual`, `automated`

          - **`transferId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`error`** · `string` · required

          - **`retryAfterAt`** · `string` · required

        - **source: "linked_transfer"**

          - **`recurringPaymentId`** · `string` · required

          - **`initiatedByKeyId`** · `string | null` · required

          - **`source`** · `string` · required · always `linked_transfer`

          - **`initialSource`** · `string` · required · one of `manual`, `automated`

          - **`transferId`** · `string` · required

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`total`** · `integer` · required

    - **`page`** · `integer` · required

    - **`pageSize`** · `integer` · required

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `recurring.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Payments: Ramps

### List on-ramp currency support
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/list-payment-onramp-currencies

> Lists generated fiat-to-crypto on-ramp pairs and the providers that support each pair.

`GET /v1/payments/ramps/onramp/currency`

Supports optional source, destination rail, and provider filters.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `onramp.read` action.

## Query parameters

- **`source`** · `string` · one of `AUD`, `BRL`, `CAD`, `CHF`, `COP`, `CZK`, `DKK`, `DOP`, `EGP`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `HKD`, `IDR`, `ILS`, `JOD`, `KES`, `KWD`, `LKR`, `MXN`, `NGN`, `NOK`, `NZD`, `OMR`, `PEN`, `PLN`, `RON`, `SEK`, `THB`, `TRY`, `TWD`, `USD`, `VND`, `ZAR` · example `USD`

  Optional fiat source currency filter.

- **`dest`** · `string` · one of `sol.solana`, `usdc.solana`, `usdt.solana`, `usdg.solana`, `pyusd.solana` · example `usdc.solana`

  Optional Solana crypto rail destination filter.

- **`provider`** · `string` · one of `moonpay`, `stripe` · example `moonpay`

  Optional ramp provider filter.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** On-ramp currency support

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    On-ramp currency support response payload.

    - **`currencies`** · `object` · required

      On-ramp currency option sets.

      - **`sources`** · `string[]` · required

        Fiat source currencies with at least one supported on-ramp pair.

      - **`destinations`** · `string[]` · required · each one of `sol.solana`, `usdc.solana`, `usdt.solana`, `usdg.solana`, `pyusd.solana`

        Crypto rails considered for Solana on-ramp support.

    - **`pairs`** · `object[]` · required

      Supported fiat-to-crypto pairs and their providers.

      - **`source`** · `string` · required · example `USD`

        Fiat source currency code.

      - **`dest`** · `string` · required · one of `sol.solana`, `usdc.solana`, `usdt.solana`, `usdg.solana`, `pyusd.solana` · example `usdc.solana`

        Destination crypto rail.

      - **`providers`** · `string[]` · required · each one of `moonpay`, `stripe`

        Providers that support this on-ramp pair.

    - **`providerDetails`** · `object` · required

      Provider support details keyed by provider ID. Includes only providers present in the returned pairs.

      - **`*`** · `object`

        Provider support details for the endpoint direction.

        - **`currencies`** · `object` · required

          Fiat currency support keyed by ISO 4217 currency code.

          - **`*`** · `object`

            Provider amount limits for one fiat currency.

            - **`min`** · `string | null` · required · example `20`

              Minimum fiat amount supported for this provider and currency.

            - **`max`** · `string | null` · required · example `30000`

              Maximum fiat amount supported for this provider and currency.

        - **`countrySupport`** · `object` · required

          Provider country coverage details.

          One of:

          - **coverage: "by-country"**

            - **`coverage`** · `string` · required · always `by-country` · example `by-country`

              Country coverage is reported per fiat currency.

            - **`countries`** · `object` · required

              Map of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes to supported fiat currencies.

              - **`*`** · `string[]`

          - **coverage: "all-currencies"**

            - **`coverage`** · `string` · required · always `all-currencies` · example `all-currencies`

              Country coverage applies to every listed provider currency.

            - **`countries`** · `string[]` · required

              ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes supported for all listed currencies.

          - **coverage: "unreported"**

            - **`coverage`** · `string` · required · always `unreported` · example `unreported`

              The provider has not reported country coverage.

        - **`entityTypes`** · `string[]` · required · each one of `individual`, `business`

          Counterparty entity types supported by this provider for the endpoint direction.

    - **`supportHash`** · `string` · required · example `sha256:example`

      Deterministic hash of the generated ramp support matrix.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `onramp.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

### Create on-ramp quote
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/create-payment-onramp-quote

> Creates an on-ramp quote with the provider you name, and the transfer that follows it.

`POST /v1/payments/ramps/onramp/quote`

`quote.deliveryMode` says how to hand the customer to the provider: `hosted` returns a provider-hosted URL, and `session_widget` a provider session to mount.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `onramp.execute` action.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Create an on-ramp quote. The response's `quote.deliveryMode` says whether to open a provider-hosted page (`hosted`) or mount a provider session widget (`session_widget`).

- **`provider`** · `string` · required · one of `moonpay`, `stripe` · example `moonpay`

  Ramp provider to quote with. The response's `quote.deliveryMode` says how that provider hands off: a hosted URL or a session widget.

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  SDP counterparty ID. Provider-native customer records may be resolved or created from this counterparty.

- **`destinationCustodyWalletId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

  Custody wallet ID (the `id` returned by the wallets API) for purchased crypto.

- **`assetRail`** · `string` · required · one of `sol.solana`, `usdc.solana`, `usdt.solana`, `usdg.solana`, `pyusd.solana` · example `usdc.solana`

  Canonical SDP crypto asset rail.

- **`fiatCurrency`** · `string` · required · one of `AUD`, `BRL`, `CAD`, `CHF`, `COP`, `CZK`, `DKK`, `DOP`, `EGP`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `HKD`, `IDR`, `ILS`, `JOD`, `KES`, `KWD`, `LKR`, `MXN`, `NGN`, `NOK`, `NZD`, `OMR`, `PEN`, `PLN`, `RON`, `SEK`, `THB`, `TRY`, `TWD`, `USD`, `VND`, `ZAR` · example `USD`

  Fiat currency for on-ramp.

- **`fiatAmount`** · `string` · required · example `100.00`

  Fiat amount to on-ramp.

- **`rampsMemo`** · `object`

  Optional key-value memo stored on the resulting transfer.

  - **`*`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 256

## Responses

- **`200`** On-ramp quote created

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    On-ramp quote response payload.

    - **`quote`** · `object` · required

      On-ramp quote details.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `ramp_quote_example`

        Quote identifier.

      - **`provider`** · `string` · required · one of `moonpay`, `stripe` · example `moonpay`

        Provider that created the quote.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · always `pending` · example `pending`

        Always `pending`: a quote opens its transfer before the customer pays, and SDP never updates the quote. Follow the transfer for progress.

      - **`deliveryMode`** · `string` · required · one of `hosted`, `session_widget` · example `hosted`

        `hosted` means open `hostedUrl`; `session_widget` means mount the provider SDK session.

      - **`hostedUrl`** · `string` · format `uri`

        Provider-hosted URL for hosted quote delivery.

      - **`clientSecret`** · `string`

        Stripe on-ramp session client secret for session widgets.

      - **`sessionId`** · `string`

        Provider session identifier for session widgets.

      - **`publishableKey`** · `string`

        Stripe publishable key used to initialize the on-ramp widget.

      - **`redirectUrl`** · `string` · format `uri`

        Provider redirect URL associated with the widget session.

    - **`transferId`** · `string` · required

      Identifier of the transfer record created for this quote. Poll GET /v1/payments/transfers/\{transferId\} for settlement status.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `onramp.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`429`** Too Many Requests

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`502`** Bad Gateway

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`503`** Service Unavailable

  Same fields as `400`.

### Simulate sandbox transfer
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/payments/simulate-sandbox-transfer

> Sandbox-only, and unavailable for every ramp provider SDP integrates: none offers a simulated pay-in, so a transfer that passes the checks below gets 400.

`POST /v1/payments/ramps/sandbox/simulate`

To complete a sandbox on-ramp, pay in the provider's own hosted page or session with its test payment details.

After the action check (`403`) and body validation (`400`), the checks run in order: a project outside Sandbox gets `403`, an unknown transfer `404`, a transfer that isn't an on-ramp `400`, one that isn't `awaiting_payment` `409`, and one whose provider the project can't use `403` or `503`.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `ramp_transfers.manage` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Names the sandbox on-ramp transfer. Only the transfer ID is accepted.

- **`transferId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `xfr_example`

  ID of a sandbox on-ramp transfer that is awaiting payment.

## Responses

- **`400`** An invalid body, a transfer that isn't an on-ramp, or one that passes every check: no ramp provider SDP integrates offers a simulated pay-in.

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `ramp_transfers.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`503`** Service Unavailable

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl -X POST 'https://api.solana.com/v1/payments/ramps/sandbox/simulate' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "transferId": "xfr_example"
  }'
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"

  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    "transferId": "xfr_example"
  })
});
```

```python tab="Python"

  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}"},
  json={
    "transferId": "xfr_example"
  })
```

### Screen an address across configured compliance providers
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/compliance/screen-compliance-address

> Runs address screening against configured compliance providers and returns provider-level risk scores.

`POST /v1/compliance/address-screenings`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `compliance.execute` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string`

  Use a unique 1–255 printable ASCII key per operation. Reuse it with the same request on retries. An in-flight attempt returns `409`; a changed request returns `422`. [Retry and recovery rules](/docs/developing-with-sdp/idempotency).

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Address compliance screening request payload.

- **`address`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `8dHEsGLpCZHZbXnFVvqWq4kMfM2pVDuNrXvVJVhQWRGZ`

  Address to screen.

- **`network`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 64 · default `solana` · example `solana`

  Network identifier expected by the compliance provider.

- **`intent`** · `string` · one of `transfer_destination`, `wallet_address_addition`, `unknown` · default `unknown` · example `transfer_destination`

  Business intent for address screening.

## Responses

- **`200`** Address screening results

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Address screening response payload.

    - **`screening`** · `object` · required

      Aggregated address screening response.

      - **`address`** · `string` · required · example `8dHEsGLpCZHZbXnFVvqWq4kMfM2pVDuNrXvVJVhQWRGZ`

        Address that was screened.

      - **`network`** · `string` · required · example `solana`

        Network that was screened.

      - **`intent`** · `string` · required · one of `transfer_destination`, `wallet_address_addition`, `unknown` · example `transfer_destination`

        Business intent for address screening.

      - **`checkedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Timestamp when all provider checks completed.

      - **`providers`** · `object[]` · required

        - **`provider`** · `string` · required · one of `range`, `elliptic`, `trm`, `chainalysis` · example `range`

          Compliance provider identifier.

        - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `ok`, `pending`, `unavailable`, `error` · example `ok`

          Provider response status.

        - **`riskScore`** · `number | null` · required · example `7`

          Risk score returned by the provider.

        - **`riskLevel`** · `string` · example `High risk`

          Provider-specific risk level label.

        - **`providerStatus`** · `string` · example `COMPLETE`

          The provider's own status word, verbatim, retained for audit; the normalized status field is the decision.

        - **`message`** · `string`

          Optional provider message, such as warnings or error details.

        - **`evaluatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

          Timestamp when the provider result was produced.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `compliance.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY=$(uuidgen)
curl -X POST 'https://api.solana.com/v1/compliance/address-screenings' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $IDEMPOTENCY_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "address": "8dHEsGLpCZHZbXnFVvqWq4kMfM2pVDuNrXvVJVhQWRGZ",
    "network": "solana",
    "intent": "transfer_destination"
  }'
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`,

    "Content-Type": "application/json"
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    "address": "8dHEsGLpCZHZbXnFVvqWq4kMfM2pVDuNrXvVJVhQWRGZ",
    "network": "solana",
    "intent": "transfer_destination"
  })
});
```

```python tab="Python"
  json={
    "address": "8dHEsGLpCZHZbXnFVvqWq4kMfM2pVDuNrXvVJVhQWRGZ",
    "network": "solana",
    "intent": "transfer_destination"
  })
```

### List counterparties
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties/list-counterparties

> Lists counterparties for the authenticated organization.

`GET /v1/counterparties`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `counterparties.read` action.

## Query parameters

- **`page`** · `integer` · greater than 0 · default `1` · example `1`

  Page number (1-based).

- **`pageSize`** · `integer` · min 1 · max 100 · default `20` · example `20`

  Items per page (max 100).

- **`includeArchived`** · `boolean` · example `false`

  Include archived counterparties in results.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Counterparties list

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Paginated list of counterparties.

    - **`counterparties`** · `object[]` · required

      Counterparties.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project scope when the counterparty is project-scoped.

      - **`externalId`** · `string | null` · required · example `customer_42`

        Caller-supplied opaque identifier for cross-system reference. Do not place personal data in this indexed field.

      - **`entityType`** · `string` · required · one of `individual`, `business` · example `individual`

        Counterparty entity type.

      - **`displayName`** · `string` · required · example `Jane Doe`

        Human-readable, searchable display name. Keep it minimal because this indexed field is not application-encrypted.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Counterparty status.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `usr_example`

        User who created the counterparty. Null when created via API key.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

    - **`total`** · `integer` · required · min 0 · example `42`

      Total counterparties matching the query.

    - **`page`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `1`

      Current page number.

    - **`pageSize`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `20`

      Items per page.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `counterparties.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

### Create counterparty
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties/create-counterparty

> Creates a counterparty.

`POST /v1/counterparties`

If externalId is provided, it must be unique within the organization.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `counterparties.manage` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string`

  Use a unique 1–255 printable ASCII key per operation. Reuse it with the same request on retries. An in-flight attempt returns `409`; a changed request returns `422`. [Retry and recovery rules](/docs/developing-with-sdp/idempotency).

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Create counterparty request body.

- **`externalId`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 256 · example `customer_42`

  Caller-supplied opaque identifier for cross-system reference. Do not place personal data in this indexed field.

- **`entityType`** · `string` · required · one of `individual`, `business` · example `individual`

  Counterparty entity type.

- **`displayName`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · max length 512 · example `Jane Doe`

  Human-readable, searchable display name. Keep it minimal because this indexed field is not application-encrypted.

## Responses

- **`201`** Counterparty created

    Counterparty response payload.

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project scope when the counterparty is project-scoped.

      - **`externalId`** · `string | null` · required · example `customer_42`

        Caller-supplied opaque identifier for cross-system reference. Do not place personal data in this indexed field.

        User who created the counterparty. Null when created via API key.

        Creation timestamp.

    Response metadata.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY=$(uuidgen)
curl -X POST 'https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $IDEMPOTENCY_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "externalId": "customer_42",
    "entityType": "individual",
    "displayName": "Jane Doe"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
// Reuse this key when you retry this request.
const idempotencyKey = crypto.randomUUID();
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`,
    "Idempotency-Key": idempotencyKey,
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    "externalId": "customer_42",
    "entityType": "individual",
    "displayName": "Jane Doe"
  })
});
```

```python tab="Python"
import os, requests, uuid

# Reuse this key when you retry this request.
idempotency_key = str(uuid.uuid4())
r = requests.post("https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}", "Idempotency-Key": idempotency_key},
  json={
    "externalId": "customer_42",
    "entityType": "individual",
    "displayName": "Jane Doe"
  })
```

### Archive counterparty
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties/archive-counterparty

> Archives a counterparty and its active accounts and provider links atomically.

`DELETE /v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}`

Archived counterparties are hidden from default lists. New transfers and batches cannot use those accounts. Recurring payments pause before their next new collection; work already in flight keeps its recovery path.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `counterparties.manage` action.

## Path parameters

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  Counterparty identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string`

  Use a unique 1–255 printable ASCII key per operation. Reuse it with the same request on retries. An in-flight attempt returns `409`; a changed request returns `422`. [Retry and recovery rules](/docs/developing-with-sdp/idempotency).

## Responses

- **`204`** Counterparty archived

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `counterparties.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY=$(uuidgen)
curl -X DELETE 'https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties/cpty_example' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $IDEMPOTENCY_KEY"
```
