### Get counterparty ramp requirements
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties/get-counterparty-requirements

> Evaluates whether a counterparty is ready to create a quote with the selected ramp provider and returns any fields or provider-hosted actions still required.

`GET /v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}/requirements`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `counterparties.read` action.

## Path parameters

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  Counterparty identifier.

## Query parameters

- **`provider`** · `string` · required · example `moonpay`

  Ramp provider to evaluate.

  Any of:

  - **string** · one of `moonpay`, `stripe`

  - **string** · always `moonpay`

- **`direction`** · `string` · required · one of `onramp`, `offramp` · example `onramp`

  Ramp direction.

- **`assetRail`** · `string` · required · one of `sol.solana`, `usdc.solana`, `usdt.solana`, `usdg.solana`, `pyusd.solana` · example `usdc.solana`

  Canonical SDP crypto asset rail.

- **`fiatCurrency`** · `string` · required · one of `AUD`, `BRL`, `CAD`, `CHF`, `COP`, `CZK`, `DKK`, `DOP`, `EGP`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `HKD`, `IDR`, `ILS`, `JOD`, `KES`, `KWD`, `LKR`, `MXN`, `NGN`, `NOK`, `NZD`, `OMR`, `PEN`, `PLN`, `RON`, `SEK`, `THB`, `TRY`, `TWD`, `USD`, `VND`, `ZAR` · example `USD`

  Fiat currency code.

- **`destinationCustodyWalletId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

  Custody wallet ID (the `id` returned by the wallets API). Required when direction is onramp.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Counterparty ramp requirements

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Current provider-specific readiness state and any fields or actions required before creating a ramp quote.

    Any of:

    - **status: "ready"**

      - **`direction`** · `string` · required · one of `onramp`, `offramp` · example `onramp`

        Ramp direction evaluated for this counterparty.

      - **`provider`** · `string` · required · one of `moonpay`, `stripe`

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · always `ready`

    - **status: "collect"**

      - **`direction`** · `string` · required · one of `onramp`, `offramp` · example `onramp`

        Ramp direction evaluated for this counterparty.

      - **`provider`** · `string` · required · one of `moonpay`, `stripe`

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · always `collect`

      - **`fields`** · `object[]` · required

        One of:

        - **kind: "text"**

          - **`kind`** · `string` · required · always `text`

          - **`key`** · `string` · required

          - **`label`** · `string` · required

          - **`required`** · `boolean` · required

          - **`pattern`** · `string`

          - **`minLength`** · `integer` · min 0

          - **`maxLength`** · `integer` · min 0

          - **`placeholder`** · `string`

          - **`mask`** · `string`

        - **kind: "select"**

          - **`kind`** · `string` · required · always `select`

          - **`key`** · `string` · required

          - **`label`** · `string` · required

          - **`required`** · `boolean` · required

          - **`options`** · `object[]` · required

            - **`value`** · `string` · required

            - **`label`** · `string` · required

        - **kind: "country"**

          - **`kind`** · `string` · required · always `country`

          - **`key`** · `string` · required

          - **`label`** · `string` · required

          - **`required`** · `boolean` · required

          - **`options`** · `string[]`

            Subset of country codes the client may offer; absent means every supported country.

        - **kind: "currency"**

          - **`kind`** · `string` · required · always `currency`

          - **`key`** · `string` · required

          - **`label`** · `string` · required

          - **`required`** · `boolean` · required

          - **`options`** · `string[]`

            Subset of fiat currencies the client may offer; absent means every supported currency.

        - **kind: "date"**

          - **`kind`** · `string` · required · always `date`

          - **`key`** · `string` · required

          - **`label`** · `string` · required

          - **`required`** · `boolean` · required

          - **`before`** · `string`

        - **kind: "address"**

          - **`kind`** · `string` · required · always `address`

          - **`key`** · `string` · required

          - **`label`** · `string` · required

          - **`required`** · `boolean` · required

          - **`fields`** · `object[]` · required

            One of:

            - **kind: "text"**

              - **`kind`** · `string` · required · always `text`

              - **`key`** · `string` · required

              - **`label`** · `string` · required

              - **`required`** · `boolean` · required

              - **`pattern`** · `string`

              - **`minLength`** · `integer` · min 0

              - **`maxLength`** · `integer` · min 0

              - **`placeholder`** · `string`

              - **`mask`** · `string`

            - **kind: "select"**

              - **`kind`** · `string` · required · always `select`

              - **`key`** · `string` · required

              - **`label`** · `string` · required

              - **`required`** · `boolean` · required

              - **`options`** · `object[]` · required

                - **`value`** · `string` · required

                - **`label`** · `string` · required

            - **kind: "country"**

              - **`kind`** · `string` · required · always `country`

              - **`key`** · `string` · required

              - **`label`** · `string` · required

              - **`required`** · `boolean` · required

              - **`options`** · `string[]`

                Subset of country codes the client may offer; absent means every supported country.

            - **kind: "currency"**

              - **`kind`** · `string` · required · always `currency`

              - **`key`** · `string` · required

              - **`label`** · `string` · required

              - **`required`** · `boolean` · required

              - **`options`** · `string[]`

                Subset of fiat currencies the client may offer; absent means every supported currency.

            - **kind: "date"**

              - **`kind`** · `string` · required · always `date`

              - **`key`** · `string` · required

              - **`label`** · `string` · required

              - **`required`** · `boolean` · required

              - **`before`** · `string`

    - **status: "unsupported"**

      - **`direction`** · `string` · required · one of `onramp`, `offramp` · example `onramp`

        Ramp direction evaluated for this counterparty.

      - **`provider`** · `string` · required · one of `moonpay`, `stripe`

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · always `unsupported`

      - **`reason`** · `string` · required

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `counterparties.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Counterparties: Accounts

### List counterparty accounts
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties/list-counterparty-accounts

> Lists payment accounts for a counterparty.

`GET /v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}/accounts`

Crypto-wallet accounts can be used by payment flows that send funds to a counterparty wallet.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `counterparties.read` action.

## Path parameters

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  Counterparty identifier.

## Query parameters

- **`page`** · `integer` · greater than 0 · default `1` · example `1`

  Page number (1-based).

- **`pageSize`** · `integer` · min 1 · max 100 · default `20` · example `20`

  Items per page (max 100).

- **`includeArchived`** · `boolean` · example `false`

  Include archived counterparty accounts in results.

- **`accountKind`** · `string` · always `crypto_wallet` · example `crypto_wallet`

  Filter accounts by account kind.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Counterparty account list

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Paginated list of counterparty accounts.

    - **`accounts`** · `object[]` · required

      Counterparty accounts.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `cpacct_example`

        Counterparty account identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty identifier.

      - **`accountKind`** · `string` · required · always `crypto_wallet` · example `crypto_wallet`

        Counterparty account kind.

      - **`label`** · `string | null` · required · example `USDC wallet`

        Optional human-readable account label.

      - **`details`** · `object` · required

        Account details. For crypto_wallet accounts, include network: "solana" and address as a Solana wallet address.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`providerAccountData`** · `object` · required

        Provider-specific account metadata preserved by SDP.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Counterparty account status.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

    - **`total`** · `integer` · required · min 0 · example `2`

      Total counterparty accounts matching the query.

    - **`page`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `1`

      Current page number.

    - **`pageSize`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `20`

      Items per page.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `counterparties.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"

```

### Create counterparty account
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties/create-counterparty-account

> Creates a payment account for a counterparty.

`POST /v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}/accounts`

For accountKind "crypto_wallet", details.network must be "solana" and details.address must be a Solana wallet address. A counterparty holds one active account per network and address: an address already on one of its active accounts answers 409 `CONFLICT` ("This address is already on this counterparty"). An archived account does not count, so re-adding its address creates a new account.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `counterparties.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  Counterparty identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string`

  Use a unique 1–255 printable ASCII key per operation. Reuse it with the same request on retries. An in-flight attempt returns `409`; a changed request returns `422`. [Retry and recovery rules](/docs/developing-with-sdp/idempotency).

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Create counterparty account request body.

- **`accountKind`** · `string` · required · always `crypto_wallet` · example `crypto_wallet`

  Counterparty account kind.

- **`label`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 256 · example `USDC wallet`

  Optional account label.

- **`details`** · `object`

  For crypto_wallet accounts, must include network: "solana" and address as a Solana wallet address.

  - **`*`** · `any`

- **`providerAccountData`** · `object`

  Provider-specific metadata to preserve with the account.

  - **`*`** · `any`

## Responses

- **`201`** Counterparty account created

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Counterparty account response payload.

    - **`account`** · `object` · required

      Counterparty payment account record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `cpacct_example`

        Counterparty account identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty identifier.

      - **`accountKind`** · `string` · required · always `crypto_wallet` · example `crypto_wallet`

        Counterparty account kind.

      - **`label`** · `string | null` · required · example `USDC wallet`

        Optional human-readable account label.

      - **`details`** · `object` · required

        Account details. For crypto_wallet accounts, include network: "solana" and address as a Solana wallet address.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`providerAccountData`** · `object` · required

        Provider-specific account metadata preserved by SDP.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Counterparty account status.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `counterparties.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY=$(uuidgen)
curl -X POST 'https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties/cpty_example/accounts' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $IDEMPOTENCY_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "accountKind": "crypto_wallet",
    "label": "USDC wallet",
    "details": {
      "network": "solana",
      "address": "7xKXtg2CW87d97TXJSDpbD5jBkheTqA83TZRuJosgAsU"
    },
    "providerAccountData": {}
  }'
```

### List counterparty provider accounts
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties/list-counterparty-provider-accounts

> Lists provider-owned fiat payout accounts for a counterparty.

`GET /v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}/provider-accounts`

Provider details are fetched just in time and account numbers are returned only as last-four digits.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `counterparties.read` action.

## Path parameters

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  Counterparty identifier.

  Filter by ramp provider.

- **`fiatCurrency`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `USD`

  Filter by fiat currency.

- **`destinationCountry`** · `string` · one of `AF`, `AX`, `AL`, `DZ`, `AS`, `AD`, `AO`, `AI`, `AQ`, `AG`, `AR`, `AM`, `AW`, `AU`, `AT`, `AZ`, `BS`, `BH`, `BD`, `BB`, `BY`, `BE`, `BZ`, `BJ`, `BM`, `BT`, `BO`, `BA`, `BW`, `BV`, `BR`, `IO`, `VG`, `BN`, `BG`, `BF`, `BI`, `KH`, `CM`, `CA`, `CV`, `BQ`, `KY`, `CF`, `TD`, `CL`, `CN`, `CX`, `CC`, `CO`, `KM`, `CG`, `CD`, `CK`, `CR`, `CI`, `HR`, `CU`, `CW`, `CY`, `CZ`, `DK`, `DJ`, `DM`, `DO`, `EC`, `EG`, `SV`, `GQ`, `ER`, `EE`, `SZ`, `ET`, `FK`, `FO`, `FJ`, `FI`, `FR`, `GF`, `PF`, `TF`, `GA`, `GM`, `GE`, `DE`, `GH`, `GI`, `GR`, `GL`, `GD`, `GP`, `GU`, `GT`, `GG`, `GN`, `GW`, `GY`, `HT`, `HM`, `HN`, `HK`, `HU`, `IS`, `IN`, `ID`, `IR`, `IQ`, `IE`, `IM`, `IL`, `IT`, `JM`, `JP`, `JE`, `JO`, `KZ`, `KE`, `KI`, `KW`, `KG`, `LA`, `LV`, `LB`, `LS`, `LR`, `LY`, `LI`, `LT`, `LU`, `MO`, `MG`, `MW`, `MY`, `MV`, `ML`, `MT`, `MH`, `MQ`, `MR`, `MU`, `YT`, `MX`, `FM`, `MD`, `MC`, `MN`, `ME`, `MS`, `MA`, `MZ`, `MM`, `NA`, `NR`, `NP`, `NL`, `NC`, `NZ`, `NI`, `NE`, `NG`, `NU`, `NF`, `KP`, `MK`, `MP`, `NO`, `OM`, `PK`, `PW`, `PS`, `PA`, `PG`, `PY`, `PE`, `PH`, `PN`, `PL`, `PT`, `PR`, `QA`, `RE`, `RO`, `RU`, `RW`, `WS`, `SM`, `ST`, `SA`, `SN`, `RS`, `SC`, `SL`, `SG`, `SX`, `SK`, `SI`, `SB`, `SO`, `ZA`, `GS`, `KR`, `SS`, `ES`, `LK`, `BL`, `SH`, `KN`, `LC`, `MF`, `PM`, `VC`, `SD`, `SR`, `SJ`, `SE`, `CH`, `SY`, `TW`, `TJ`, `TZ`, `TH`, `TL`, `TG`, `TK`, `TO`, `TT`, `TN`, `TR`, `TM`, `TC`, `TV`, `UM`, `VI`, `UG`, `UA`, `AE`, `GB`, `US`, `UY`, `UZ`, `VU`, `VA`, `VE`, `VN`, `WF`, `EH`, `YE`, `ZM`, `ZW` · example `US`

  Filter by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 destination country.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Counterparty provider-account list

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Counterparty provider-account list.

    - **`accounts`** · `object[]` · required

      External provider accounts for the counterparty.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `counterparty_provider_account_example`

        Counterparty provider-account row identifier.

      - **`provider`** · `string` · required · one of `moonpay`, `stripe`, `hercle`, `mural`, `moneygram`, `lightspark`, `coinbase`, `bvnk` · example `moonpay`

        Ramp provider owning the account. A retired provider's accounts keep its id.

      - **`kind`** · `string` · required · one of `customer_link`, `payout_account`, `funding_wallet`, `merchant_wallet` · example `funding_wallet`

        Provider-account resource kind.

      - **`fiatCurrency`** · `string | null` · required · example `USD`

        Fiat currency for the provider account corridor. Null on customer-link rows.

      - **`destinationCountry`** · `string | null` · required · one of `AF`, `AX`, `AL`, `DZ`, `AS`, `AD`, `AO`, `AI`, `AQ`, `AG`, `AR`, `AM`, `AW`, `AU`, `AT`, `AZ`, `BS`, `BH`, `BD`, `BB`, `BY`, `BE`, `BZ`, `BJ`, `BM`, `BT`, `BO`, `BA`, `BW`, `BV`, `BR`, `IO`, `VG`, `BN`, `BG`, `BF`, `BI`, `KH`, `CM`, `CA`, `CV`, `BQ`, `KY`, `CF`, `TD`, `CL`, `CN`, `CX`, `CC`, `CO`, `KM`, `CG`, `CD`, `CK`, `CR`, `CI`, `HR`, `CU`, `CW`, `CY`, `CZ`, `DK`, `DJ`, `DM`, `DO`, `EC`, `EG`, `SV`, `GQ`, `ER`, `EE`, `SZ`, `ET`, `FK`, `FO`, `FJ`, `FI`, `FR`, `GF`, `PF`, `TF`, `GA`, `GM`, `GE`, `DE`, `GH`, `GI`, `GR`, `GL`, `GD`, `GP`, `GU`, `GT`, `GG`, `GN`, `GW`, `GY`, `HT`, `HM`, `HN`, `HK`, `HU`, `IS`, `IN`, `ID`, `IR`, `IQ`, `IE`, `IM`, `IL`, `IT`, `JM`, `JP`, `JE`, `JO`, `KZ`, `KE`, `KI`, `KW`, `KG`, `LA`, `LV`, `LB`, `LS`, `LR`, `LY`, `LI`, `LT`, `LU`, `MO`, `MG`, `MW`, `MY`, `MV`, `ML`, `MT`, `MH`, `MQ`, `MR`, `MU`, `YT`, `MX`, `FM`, `MD`, `MC`, `MN`, `ME`, `MS`, `MA`, `MZ`, `MM`, `NA`, `NR`, `NP`, `NL`, `NC`, `NZ`, `NI`, `NE`, `NG`, `NU`, `NF`, `KP`, `MK`, `MP`, `NO`, `OM`, `PK`, `PW`, `PS`, `PA`, `PG`, `PY`, `PE`, `PH`, `PN`, `PL`, `PT`, `PR`, `QA`, `RE`, `RO`, `RU`, `RW`, `WS`, `SM`, `ST`, `SA`, `SN`, `RS`, `SC`, `SL`, `SG`, `SX`, `SK`, `SI`, `SB`, `SO`, `ZA`, `GS`, `KR`, `SS`, `ES`, `LK`, `BL`, `SH`, `KN`, `LC`, `MF`, `PM`, `VC`, `SD`, `SR`, `SJ`, `SE`, `CH`, `SY`, `TW`, `TJ`, `TZ`, `TH`, `TL`, `TG`, `TK`, `TO`, `TT`, `TN`, `TR`, `TM`, `TC`, `TV`, `UM`, `VI`, `UG`, `UA`, `AE`, `GB`, `US`, `UY`, `UZ`, `VU`, `VA`, `VE`, `VN`, `WF`, `EH`, `YE`, `ZM`, `ZW` · example `US`

        Destination country for the provider account corridor. Null on customer-link rows.

      - **`paymentRail`** · `string | null` · required · example `ACH`

        Payment rail selected for the corridor row.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Counterparty account status.

      - **`providerStatus`** · `string | null` · required · example `ACTIVE`

        Current provider-side account status when known.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        SDP row creation timestamp.

      - **`customerLink`** · `object`

        The counterparty's provider customer link, present once the provider onboarding has started.

        - **`provider`** · `string` · required · one of `moonpay`, `stripe`, `hercle`, `mural`, `moneygram`, `lightspark`, `coinbase`, `bvnk`

        - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `counterparty_provider_account_customer`

          Customer-link row identifier.

        - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `archived` · example `active`

          Counterparty account status.

        - **`providerStatus`** · `string | null` · required · example `ACTIVE`

          Provider-side customer status when known.

        - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

          Customer-link row creation timestamp.

        - **`providerCustomerReference`** · `string` · required · example `Customer:0193b2c4`

          Provider-side customer identifier for the counterparty.

      - **`providerAccountReference`** · `string` · example `a:26091815750755:c1aVEgc:1`

        The provider's own wallet/account id; present on wallet kinds once the provider assigned it.

      - **`balance`** · `object`

        Live provider-wallet balance, fetched just in time; present only on wallet kinds whose reference exists. unavailable keeps the row visible when the provider read fails.

        One of:

        - **state: "available"**

          - **`state`** · `string` · required · always `available`

          - **`amount`** · `string` · required · example `9.90`

            Live wallet balance as a decimal string.

          - **`currency`** · `string` · required · example `USD`

            Balance currency.

        - **state: "unavailable"**

          - **`state`** · `string` · required · always `unavailable`

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `counterparties.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`503`** Service Unavailable

  Same fields as `400`.

### Update counterparty account
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties/update-counterparty-account

> Updates a counterparty payment account.

`PATCH /v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}/accounts/{counterpartyAccountId}`

At least one field must be provided. Changing details to an address already on another of the counterparty's active accounts answers 409 `CONFLICT`.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `counterparties.execute` action.

## Path parameters

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  Counterparty identifier.

- **`counterpartyAccountId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpacct_example`

  Counterparty account identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string`

  Use a unique 1–255 printable ASCII key per operation. Reuse it with the same request on retries. An in-flight attempt returns `409`; a changed request returns `422`. [Retry and recovery rules](/docs/developing-with-sdp/idempotency).

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Update counterparty account request body. At least one field must be provided.

- **`label`** · `string | null` · min length 1 · max length 256 · example `Primary USDC wallet`

  Updated account label. Use null to clear.

- **`details`** · `object`

  Updated account details. Crypto-wallet accounts must retain network: "solana" and a valid Solana wallet address.

  - **`*`** · `any`

- **`providerAccountData`** · `object`

  Updated provider-specific metadata.

  - **`*`** · `any`

## Responses

- **`200`** Counterparty account updated

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Counterparty account response payload.

    - **`account`** · `object` · required

      Counterparty payment account record.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `cpacct_example`

        Counterparty account identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

        Counterparty identifier.

      - **`accountKind`** · `string` · required · always `crypto_wallet` · example `crypto_wallet`

        Counterparty account kind.

      - **`label`** · `string | null` · required · example `USDC wallet`

        Optional human-readable account label.

      - **`details`** · `object` · required

        Account details. For crypto_wallet accounts, include network: "solana" and address as a Solana wallet address.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`providerAccountData`** · `object` · required

        Provider-specific account metadata preserved by SDP.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Counterparty account status.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `counterparties.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY=$(uuidgen)
curl -X PATCH 'https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties/cpty_example/accounts/cpacct_example' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $IDEMPOTENCY_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "label": "Primary USDC wallet",
    "details": {
      "network": "solana",
      "address": "7xKXtg2CW87d97TXJSDpbD5jBkheTqA83TZRuJosgAsU"
    },
    "providerAccountData": {}
  }'
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
// Reuse this key when you retry this request.
const idempotencyKey = crypto.randomUUID();
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties/cpty_example/accounts/cpacct_example", {
  method: "PATCH",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`,
    "Idempotency-Key": idempotencyKey,
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
  },

    "label": "Primary USDC wallet",
```

### Archive counterparty account
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/counterparties/archive-counterparty-account

> Archives a counterparty payment account.

`DELETE /v1/counterparties/{counterpartyId}/accounts/{counterpartyAccountId}`

Archived accounts are hidden from default lists.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `counterparties.manage` action.

## Path parameters

- **`counterpartyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpty_example`

  Counterparty identifier.

- **`counterpartyAccountId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `cpacct_example`

  Counterparty account identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string`

  Use a unique 1–255 printable ASCII key per operation. Reuse it with the same request on retries. An in-flight attempt returns `409`; a changed request returns `422`. [Retry and recovery rules](/docs/developing-with-sdp/idempotency).

## Responses

- **`204`** Counterparty account archived

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `counterparties.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`422`** Unprocessable Entity

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY=$(uuidgen)
curl -X DELETE 'https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties/cpty_example/accounts/cpacct_example' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $IDEMPOTENCY_KEY"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
// Reuse this key when you retry this request.
const idempotencyKey = crypto.randomUUID();
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties/cpty_example/accounts/cpacct_example", {
  method: "DELETE",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`,
    "Idempotency-Key": idempotencyKey
  }
});
```

```python tab="Python"
import os, requests, uuid

# Reuse this key when you retry this request.
idempotency_key = str(uuid.uuid4())
r = requests.delete("https://api.solana.com/v1/counterparties/cpty_example/accounts/cpacct_example",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}", "Idempotency-Key": idempotency_key})
```

## Example responses

```json tab="403"

  "error": {
    "code": "INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS",

      "action": "counterparties.manage"
    }
```

### List asset profiles
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/asset-profiles/list-asset-profiles

> Lists asset profiles for the authenticated organization and project.

`GET /v1/issuance/asset-profiles`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.read` action.

## Query parameters

- **`page`** · `integer` · greater than 0 · default `1` · example `1`

  Page number (1-based).

- **`pageSize`** · `integer` · min 1 · max 100 · default `20` · example `20`

  Items per page (max 100).

- **`includeArchived`** · `boolean` · example `false`

  Include archived asset profiles in results.

- **`category`** · `string` · one of `generic`, `stablecoin`, `tokenized_security` · example `stablecoin`

  Filter by asset category.

- **`tokenIds`** · `string` · example `tok_abc123,tok_def456`

  Restrict results to these token ids as a comma-separated list (max 100). Lets a client hydrate exactly the tokens on the page it is rendering.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Asset profiles list

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Paginated list of asset profiles.

    - **`assetProfiles`** · `object[]` · required

      Asset profiles.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `asset_profile_example`

        Asset profile identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · example `tok_example`

        Identifier of the issued token this profile describes.

      - **`assetCategory`** · `string` · required · one of `generic`, `stablecoin`, `tokenized_security` · example `stablecoin`

        Broad product/regulatory grouping for an issued asset.

      - **`assetType`** · `string` · required · example `fiat_backed`

        Concrete asset type within the category.

      - **`assetTypeVersion`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `2`

        Version of the asset type registry contract this profile was validated against.

      - **`issuanceMetadata`** · `object` · required

        Canonical, private master metadata for the asset. SDP-owned namespaces (asset, compliance, chain) plus a namespaced custom bucket (customer, integration). The optional `visibility.public` array holds the issuance_metadata dot-paths the issuer chose to expose publicly; when omitted, the asset type's registry default is used. Only asset.* and chain.decimals paths can ever be projected publicly — compliance and custom fields are private by default and can never be exposed, even if listed in visibility.public. The optional `settings` namespace holds the selected advanced (Token-2022) settings; `version` is server-stamped and each selected key is validated against the asset type's capability.

        - **`asset`** · `object`

          - **`*`** · `any`

        - **`compliance`** · `object`

          - **`*`** · `any`

        - **`chain`** · `object`

          - **`*`** · `any`

        - **`custom`** · `object`

          - **`customer`** · `object`

            - **`*`** · `any`

          - **`integration`** · `object`

            - **`*`** · `any`

        - **`visibility`** · `object`

          - **`public`** · `string[]`

        - **`settings`** · `object`

          - **`version`** · `integer` · greater than 0

          - **`selected`** · `object` · required

            - **`*`** · `object`

              - **`params`** · `object`

                - **`*`** · `string | number`

                  Any of:

                  - **string**

                  - **number**

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`publicMetadata`** · `object` · required

        Safe public subset of the issuance metadata, derived via the asset type's projection rules. Served by the public token metadata URI.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Asset profile status.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `usr_example`

        User who created the profile. Null when created via API key.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

    - **`total`** · `integer` · required · min 0 · example `7`

      Total asset profiles matching the query.

    - **`page`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `1`

      Current page number.

    - **`pageSize`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `20`

      Items per page.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request


### Create token with asset profile
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/asset-profiles/create-token-with-asset-profile

> Creates an issued token and its asset profile atomically in a single transaction: if either write fails, both roll back, so a token is never persisted without a profile.

`POST /v1/issuance/asset-profiles`

Requires the Asset Profiles feature to be enabled.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.manage` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Create token + asset profile request body: the token-create fields plus the asset profile's category, type, and issuance metadata. The token and its profile are created atomically.

- **`name`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · max length 100 · example `Example Token`

  Token name.

- **`symbol`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · max length 10 · pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9]+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9]+)*$` · example `EXM`

  Ticker symbol.

- **`signingCustodyWalletId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

  Optional exact SDP Wallet ID for direct deployment. A draft may defer selection until deploy.

- **`decimals`** · `integer` · min 0 · max 18 · example `6`

  Token decimals.

- **`description`** · `string` · max length 500 · example `Example token description.`

  Token description.

- **`uri`** · `string` · format `uri` · max length 512 · example `https://example.com/metadata.json`

  Metadata URI passed to on-chain token metadata (points to off-chain JSON).

- **`imageUrl`** · `string` · format `uri` · max length 512 · example `https://example.com/token.png`

  Token image URL.

- **`maxSupply`** · `string` · example `1000000`

  Maximum supply as a string (UI units).

- **`template`** · `string` · one of `stablecoin`, `arcade`, `tokenized-security`, `custom` · example `stablecoin`

  Token template preset. Defaults to 'custom' if not specified.

- **`overrides`** · `object`

  Template overrides to customize defaults.

  - **`extensions`** · `object`

    Override template extension configuration.

    - **`transferFee`** · `boolean | object`

      Transfer fee configuration or false to disable.

      Any of:

      - **boolean** · always `false`

      - **object**

        - **`basisPoints`** · `integer` · required · min 0 · max 10000 · example `50`

          Transfer fee in basis points.

        - **`maxFee`** · `string` · required · example `0.5`

          Maximum fee in UI units.

        - **`transferFeeConfigAuthority`** · `string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority to configure transfer fees. Defaults to platform authority.

        - **`withdrawWithheldAuthority`** · `string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority to withdraw withheld fees. Defaults to platform authority.

    - **`interestBearing`** · `boolean | object`

      Interest-bearing configuration or false to disable.

      Any of:

      - **boolean** · always `false`

      - **object**

        - **`rate`** · `number` · required · example `2.5`

          Interest rate in percent.

        - **`rateAuthority`** · `string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority that can update the rate. Defaults to platform authority.

    - **`permanentDelegate`** · `boolean | string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

      Permanent delegate authority address, or false to disable.

      Any of:

      - **boolean** · always `false`

      - **string**

    - **`pausable`** · `boolean | object`

      Pausable configuration or false to disable.

      Any of:

      - **boolean** · always `false`

      - **object**

        - **`authority`** · `string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority that can pause/resume transfers. Defaults to platform authority.

    - **`nonTransferable`** · `boolean` · example `false`

      Enable/disable non-transferable.

    - **`defaultAccountState`** · `string` · one of `initialized`, `frozen` · example `frozen`

      Override default account state.

    - **`scaledUiAmount`** · `boolean | object`

      Scaled UI amount configuration or false to disable.

      Any of:

      - **boolean** · always `false`

      - **object**

        - **`authority`** · `string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority that can update scaled UI parameters. Defaults to platform authority.

        - **`multiplier`** · `number` · required · example `1`

          Current UI multiplier.

        - **`newMultiplier`** · `number` · example `2`

          Scheduled multiplier.

        - **`newMultiplierEffectiveTimestamp`** · `integer` · example `1735689600`

          Unix timestamp (seconds) when the new multiplier takes effect.

    - **`transferHook`** · `boolean | object`

      Transfer hook configuration or false to disable.

      Any of:

      - **boolean** · always `false`

      - **object**

        - **`programId`** · `string` · required · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Transfer hook program id.

        - **`authority`** · `string` · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Authority that can update the hook program. Defaults to platform authority.

  - **`requiresAllowlist`** · `boolean` · example `true`

    Override allowlist requirement (if template allows).

- **`requiresAllowlist`** · `boolean` · example `true`

  Require allowlist checks for transfers.

- **`isMintable`** · `boolean` · example `true`

  Allow minting after creation.

- **`isFreezable`** · `boolean` · example `true`

  Allow freezing token accounts.

- **`assetCategory`** · `string` · one of `generic`, `stablecoin`, `tokenized_security` · default `generic` · example `stablecoin`

  Asset category for the token's profile. Defaults to generic.

- **`assetType`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 128 · default `generic` · example `fiat_backed`

  Asset type within the category. Must be supported for the category.

- **`issuanceMetadata`** · `object`

  Optional canonical issuance metadata for the profile. Public metadata is derived from it.

  - **`asset`** · `object`

    - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`compliance`** · `object`

    - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`chain`** · `object`

    - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`custom`** · `object`

    - **`customer`** · `object`

      - **`*`** · `any`

    - **`integration`** · `object`

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`visibility`** · `object`

    - **`public`** · `string[]`

  - **`settings`** · `object`

    - **`version`** · `integer` · greater than 0

    - **`selected`** · `object` · required

      - **`*`** · `object`

        - **`params`** · `object`

          - **`*`** · `string | number`

            Any of:

            - **string**

            - **number**

  - **`*`** · `any`

## Responses

- **`201`** Token and asset profile created

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Token + asset profile response payload.

    - **`token`** · `object` · required

      The created token.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

        Token identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`signingCustodyWalletId`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `cwlt_example`

        Exact deployment wallet selected for a pending token, or historical deployment attribution after deployment. This is not the current signer for later authority operations.

      - **`mintAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Mint address once deployed.

      - **`mintAuthority`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Mint authority address, if set.

      - **`freezeAuthority`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        Freeze authority address, if set.

      - **`ablListAddress`** · `string | null` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

        On-chain allowlist/blocklist address, if enabled.

      - **`name`** · `string` · required · example `Example Token`

        Token name.

      - **`symbol`** · `string` · required · example `EXM`

        Token symbol.

      - **`decimals`** · `integer` · required · example `9`

        Token decimals.

      - **`description`** · `string | null` · required · example `Example token description.`

        Token description.

      - **`uri`** · `string | null` · required · example `https://example.com/metadata.json`

        Metadata URI passed to on-chain token metadata (points to off-chain JSON).

      - **`imageUrl`** · `string | null` · required · example `https://example.com/token.png`

        Token image URL.

      - **`template`** · `string` · required · one of `stablecoin`, `arcade`, `tokenized-security`, `custom`, `rwa` · example `stablecoin`

        Token template identifier.

      - **`extensions`** · `object | null` · required

        Token-2022 extensions configuration.

        - **`transferFee`** · `object`

          Transfer fee configuration.

          - **`basisPoints`** · `integer` · required · min 0 · max 10000 · example `25`

            Transfer fee in basis points (0-10000).

          - **`maxFee`** · `string` · required · example `0.5`

            Maximum fee in UI units.

          - **`transferFeeConfigAuthority`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority to configure transfer fees.

          - **`withdrawWithheldAuthority`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority to withdraw withheld fees.

        - **`interestBearing`** · `object`

          Interest-bearing configuration.

          - **`rate`** · `number` · required · example `2.5`

            Interest rate in percent.

          - **`rateAuthority`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can update the rate.

        - **`permanentDelegate`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

          Permanent delegate address.

        - **`pausable`** · `object`

          Pausable configuration.

          - **`authority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can pause/resume transfers.

        - **`nonTransferable`** · `boolean` · example `false`

          Mark token as non-transferable.

        - **`defaultAccountState`** · `string` · one of `initialized`, `frozen` · example `initialized`

          Default account state.

        - **`scaledUiAmount`** · `object`

          Scaled UI amount configuration.

          - **`authority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can update scaled UI parameters.

          - **`multiplier`** · `number` · required · example `1`

            Current UI multiplier.

          - **`newMultiplier`** · `number` · required · example `2`

            Scheduled multiplier.

          - **`newMultiplierEffectiveTimestamp`** · `integer` · required · example `1735689600`

            Unix timestamp (seconds) when the new multiplier takes effect.

        - **`transferHook`** · `object`

          Transfer hook configuration.

          - **`programId`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Transfer hook program id.

          - **`authority`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · example `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112`

            Authority that can update the transfer hook program.

      - **`totalSupply`** · `string` · required · example `1000000`

        Cached total supply in UI units (stored to avoid frequent RPC reads). Use POST /v1/issuance/tokens/\{tokenId\}/supply/refresh to force an on-chain refresh.

      - **`totalSupplyUpdatedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `null`

        Timestamp when supply was last refreshed.

      - **`maxSupply`** · `string | null` · required · example `10000000`

        Maximum supply in UI units, if capped.

      - **`isMintable`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

        Whether additional minting is allowed.

      - **`isFreezable`** · `boolean` · required · example `true`

        Whether freeze authority is enabled.

      - **`requiresAllowlist`** · `boolean` · required · example `false`

        Whether transfers require allowlist approval.

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `pending`, `active`, `paused`, `revoked` · example `active`

        Token lifecycle status.

      - **`deployedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-05T00:00:00.000Z`

        Deployment timestamp, if deployed.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string` · required · example `key_example`

        Actor identifier that created the token.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

    - **`assetProfile`** · `object` · required

      The created asset profile.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `asset_profile_example`

        Asset profile identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · example `tok_example`

        Identifier of the issued token this profile describes.

      - **`assetCategory`** · `string` · required · one of `generic`, `stablecoin`, `tokenized_security` · example `stablecoin`

        Broad product/regulatory grouping for an issued asset.

      - **`assetType`** · `string` · required · example `fiat_backed`

        Concrete asset type within the category.

      - **`assetTypeVersion`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `2`

        Version of the asset type registry contract this profile was validated against.

      - **`issuanceMetadata`** · `object` · required

        Canonical, private master metadata for the asset. SDP-owned namespaces (asset, compliance, chain) plus a namespaced custom bucket (customer, integration). The optional `visibility.public` array holds the issuance_metadata dot-paths the issuer chose to expose publicly; when omitted, the asset type's registry default is used. Only asset.* and chain.decimals paths can ever be projected publicly — compliance and custom fields are private by default and can never be exposed, even if listed in visibility.public. The optional `settings` namespace holds the selected advanced (Token-2022) settings; `version` is server-stamped and each selected key is validated against the asset type's capability.

        - **`asset`** · `object`

          - **`*`** · `any`

        - **`compliance`** · `object`

          - **`*`** · `any`

        - **`chain`** · `object`

          - **`*`** · `any`

        - **`custom`** · `object`

          - **`customer`** · `object`

            - **`*`** · `any`

          - **`integration`** · `object`

            - **`*`** · `any`

        - **`visibility`** · `object`

          - **`public`** · `string[]`

        - **`settings`** · `object`

          - **`version`** · `integer` · greater than 0

          - **`selected`** · `object` · required

            - **`*`** · `object`

              - **`params`** · `object`

                - **`*`** · `string | number`

                  Any of:

                  - **string**

                  - **number**

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`publicMetadata`** · `object` · required

        Safe public subset of the issuance metadata, derived via the asset type's projection rules. Served by the public token metadata URI.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Asset profile status.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `usr_example`

        User who created the profile. Null when created via API key.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl -X POST 'https://api.solana.com/v1/issuance/asset-profiles' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Example Token",
    "symbol": "EXM",
    "signingCustodyWalletId": "cwlt_example",
    "decimals": 6,
    "description": "Example token description.",
    "uri": "https://example.com/metadata.json",
    "imageUrl": "https://example.com/token.png",
    "maxSupply": "1000000",
    "template": "stablecoin",
    "overrides": {

        "transferFee": {
          "basisPoints": 50,
```

### Get asset profile by token
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/asset-profiles/get-asset-profile-by-token

> Gets the active asset profile for an issued token, if one exists.

`GET /v1/issuance/asset-profiles/by-token/{tokenId}`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.read` action.

## Path parameters

- **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `tok_example`

  Token identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Asset profile

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Asset profile response payload.

    - **`assetProfile`** · `object` · required

        Asset profile identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · example `tok_example`

        Identifier of the issued token this profile describes.

      - **`assetCategory`** · `string` · required · one of `generic`, `stablecoin`, `tokenized_security` · example `stablecoin`

        Broad product/regulatory grouping for an issued asset.

      - **`assetType`** · `string` · required · example `fiat_backed`

        Concrete asset type within the category.

      - **`assetTypeVersion`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `2`

        Version of the asset type registry contract this profile was validated against.

      - **`issuanceMetadata`** · `object` · required

        Canonical, private master metadata for the asset. SDP-owned namespaces (asset, compliance, chain) plus a namespaced custom bucket (customer, integration). The optional `visibility.public` array holds the issuance_metadata dot-paths the issuer chose to expose publicly; when omitted, the asset type's registry default is used. Only asset.* and chain.decimals paths can ever be projected publicly — compliance and custom fields are private by default and can never be exposed, even if listed in visibility.public. The optional `settings` namespace holds the selected advanced (Token-2022) settings; `version` is server-stamped and each selected key is validated against the asset type's capability.

        - **`asset`** · `object`

          - **`*`** · `any`

        - **`chain`** · `object`

          - **`*`** · `any`

        - **`custom`** · `object`

          - **`customer`** · `object`

            - **`*`** · `any`

          - **`integration`** · `object`

            - **`*`** · `any`

        - **`visibility`** · `object`

          - **`public`** · `string[]`

        - **`settings`** · `object`

          - **`version`** · `integer` · greater than 0

                  - **string**

        Safe public subset of the issuance metadata, derived via the asset type's projection rules. Served by the public token metadata URI.

        - **`*`** · `any`

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`404`** Not Found

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `401`.

### Get asset profile
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/asset-profiles/get-asset-profile

> Gets an asset profile by id.

`GET /v1/issuance/asset-profiles/{profileId}`

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.read` action.

## Path parameters

- **`profileId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `asset_profile_example`

  Asset profile identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Asset profile

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Asset profile response payload.

    - **`assetProfile`** · `object` · required

      Asset profile record: SDP-owned description of what an issued token represents.

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `asset_profile_example`

        Asset profile identifier.

      - **`organizationId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `org_example`

        Organization identifier.

      - **`projectId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

        Project identifier.

      - **`tokenId`** · `string` · required · example `tok_example`

        Identifier of the issued token this profile describes.

      - **`assetCategory`** · `string` · required · one of `generic`, `stablecoin`, `tokenized_security` · example `stablecoin`

        Broad product/regulatory grouping for an issued asset.

      - **`assetType`** · `string` · required · example `fiat_backed`

        Concrete asset type within the category.

      - **`assetTypeVersion`** · `integer` · required · greater than 0 · example `2`

        Version of the asset type registry contract this profile was validated against.

      - **`issuanceMetadata`** · `object` · required

        Canonical, private master metadata for the asset. SDP-owned namespaces (asset, compliance, chain) plus a namespaced custom bucket (customer, integration). The optional `visibility.public` array holds the issuance_metadata dot-paths the issuer chose to expose publicly; when omitted, the asset type's registry default is used. Only asset.* and chain.decimals paths can ever be projected publicly — compliance and custom fields are private by default and can never be exposed, even if listed in visibility.public. The optional `settings` namespace holds the selected advanced (Token-2022) settings; `version` is server-stamped and each selected key is validated against the asset type's capability.

        - **`asset`** · `object`

          - **`*`** · `any`

        - **`compliance`** · `object`

          - **`*`** · `any`

        - **`chain`** · `object`

          - **`*`** · `any`

        - **`custom`** · `object`

          - **`customer`** · `object`

            - **`*`** · `any`

          - **`integration`** · `object`

            - **`*`** · `any`

        - **`visibility`** · `object`

          - **`public`** · `string[]`

        - **`settings`** · `object`

          - **`version`** · `integer` · greater than 0

          - **`selected`** · `object` · required

            - **`*`** · `object`

              - **`params`** · `object`

                - **`*`** · `string | number`

                  Any of:

                  - **string**

                  - **number**

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`publicMetadata`** · `object` · required

        Safe public subset of the issuance metadata, derived via the asset type's projection rules. Served by the public token metadata URI.

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `archived` · example `active`

        Asset profile status.

      - **`createdBy`** · `string | null` · required · min length 1 · example `usr_example`

        User who created the profile. Null when created via API key.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        Creation timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-02T00:00:00.000Z`

        Last update timestamp.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `401`.

### Update asset profile
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/asset-profiles/update-asset-profile

> Updates an asset profile.

`PATCH /v1/issuance/asset-profiles/{profileId}`

At least one field must be provided. The resulting category/type pair must be supported. Public metadata is recomputed when metadata or the asset type changes; set issuanceMetadata.visibility.public to control which fields are exposed (asset.* and chain.decimals only).

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.manage` action.

## Path parameters

- **`profileId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `asset_profile_example`

  Asset profile identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Update asset profile request body. At least one field must be provided.

- **`assetCategory`** · `string` · one of `generic`, `stablecoin`, `tokenized_security` · example `stablecoin`

  Updated asset category. Must remain consistent with the asset type.

- **`assetType`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 128 · example `fiat_backed`

  Updated asset type. Must be supported for the (resulting) category.

- **`issuanceMetadata`** · `object`

  Updated issuance metadata. Replaces the existing object; public metadata is recomputed.

  - **`asset`** · `object`

    - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`compliance`** · `object`

    - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`chain`** · `object`

    - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`custom`** · `object`

    - **`customer`** · `object`

      - **`*`** · `any`

    - **`integration`** · `object`

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`visibility`** · `object`

    - **`public`** · `string[]`

  - **`settings`** · `object`

    - **`version`** · `integer` · greater than 0

    - **`selected`** · `object` · required

      - **`*`** · `object`

        - **`params`** · `object`

          - **`*`** · `string | number`

            Any of:

            - **string**

            - **number**

  - **`*`** · `any`

```json tab="403"
    "message": "Missing action: issuance.manage",
    "details": {
      "action": "issuance.manage"
    }
  },
  "meta": {
    "requestId": "req_example"
  }
}
```

Error responses use the [standard error shape](/docs/reference/conventions/errors).

### Archive asset profile
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/asset-profiles/archive-asset-profile

> Archives an asset profile.

`DELETE /v1/issuance/asset-profiles/{profileId}`

Archived profiles are hidden from default lists.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `issuance.manage` action.

## Path parameters

- **`profileId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `asset_profile_example`

  Asset profile identifier.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`204`** Asset profile archived

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `issuance.manage` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `401`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `401`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl -X DELETE 'https://api.solana.com/v1/issuance/asset-profiles/asset_profile_example' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/issuance/asset-profiles/asset_profile_example", {
  method: "DELETE",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`
  }
});
```

```python tab="Python"
import os, requests

r = requests.delete("https://api.solana.com/v1/issuance/asset-profiles/asset_profile_example",
  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}"})
```

## Example responses

```json tab="403"
{
  "error": {
    "code": "INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS",
    "message": "Missing action: issuance.manage",
    "details": {
      "action": "issuance.manage"
    }
  },
  "meta": {
    "requestId": "req_example"
  }
}
```

Error responses use the [standard error shape](/docs/reference/conventions/errors).
