## Earn: Discovery

### List strategies
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/earn/list-earn-strategies

> Lists the strategies your project can see, largest first by total value locked.

> **Earn is under active development.** Features, API endpoints, and docs may change.

`GET /v1/earn/strategies`

The list defaults to your project's cluster: devnet for sandbox, mainnet for production. Pass `cluster` to browse the other cluster's strategies; those rows are always `fundable: false`. A listed strategy is not always open for deposits, so check `fundable` and `status` before you offer it.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `earn.read` action.

## Query parameters

- **`page`** · `integer` · greater than 0 · default `1`

- **`pageSize`** · `integer` · min 1 · max 100 · default `20`

- **`sourceKind`** · `string` · one of `defi`, `rwa`

- **`apyType`** · `string` · one of `variable`, `fixed`

- **`liquidityTerm`** · `string` · one of `instant`, `delayed`

- **`cluster`** · `string` · one of `devnet`, `mainnet-beta`

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** One page of strategies

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    - **`strategies`** · `object[]` · required

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `earn_strategy_3b6a81ce-00b0-4c5a-9761-cb359932e97e`

        The strategy's ID. Pass it as `strategyId` to preview or build a deposit.

      - **`provider`** · `string` · required · example `kamino`

        Open provider id (e.g. `kamino`, `veda`).

      - **`providerReference`** · `string` · required · example `7uib8xGAwkaPz4ZGCA6t8sSEid5Yp9ty13PHUweTypx`

        The strategy's onchain address at the provider, such as a vault. It identifies the instrument; never send funds to it.

      - **`name`** · `string` · required · example `Allez USDC`

      - **`sourceKind`** · `string` · required · one of `defi`, `rwa`

        Where the yield comes from: onchain DeFi or real-world assets.

      - **`underlyingSource`** · `string` · example `kamino`

        Open id of the underlying protocol or fund, when the provider reports one.

      - **`depositMints`** · `string[]` · required

        Mints the strategy accepts directly. The first is the deposit token.

      - **`shareMint`** · `string` · example `hXm2xSRF5PLKGMrTvAWqKhR76MuJX5dAabeSChkjqu2`

        The share token a deposit mints, when the strategy has one.

      - **`apyType`** · `string` · required · one of `variable`, `fixed`

      - **`currentApy`** · `string` · example `0.062`

        Latest observed APY as a decimal ratio string (`"0.062"` = 6.2%), refreshed about every five minutes. Absent when the provider reports none.

      - **`liquidityTerm`** · `string` · required · one of `instant`, `delayed`

      - **`redemptionDelayDays`** · `number` · example `2`

        For `delayed` liquidity: the provider's stated redemption delay.

      - **`riskMetadata`** · `object`

        Curator and risk framework metadata, as published by the provider. Curators publish heterogeneous frameworks, so this is an open shape.

        - **`curator`** · `string` · example `allez`

        - **`riskTier`** · `string`

        - **`frameworkUrl`** · `string`

        - **`*`** · `any`

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `active`, `paused`, `deprecated`

        The strategy's lifecycle. Only `active` strategies accept new deposits.

      - **`depositSlippage`** · `object | null` · required

        Not null when a deposit build for this strategy, in your environment, requires `minSharesOut`. Preview the deposit first and derive the floor from `sharesOut` minus your tolerance. Most production strategies are not null; a strategy priced later, such as a provider order, may be null because no onchain instruction can enforce a floor. Answered per request, like `fundable`.

        - **`quoteRequired`** · `boolean` · required · always `true`

          The live quote endpoint must be called before building this direction.

        - **`defaultToleranceBps`** · `integer` · required · example `50`

          Suggested tolerance in basis points, to take off a preview's quote when you compute the floor. Your customer may choose another.

      - **`withdrawalSlippage`** · `object | null` · required

        Non-null when this provider's withdrawal builder refuses to run without an explicit `minAmountOut`: call the withdrawal preview first and derive the floor from `assetsOut`. Null when this withdrawal cannot enforce a floor; omit `minAmountOut`.

        - **`quoteRequired`** · `boolean` · required · always `true`

          The live quote endpoint must be called before building this direction.

        - **`defaultToleranceBps`** · `integer` · required · example `50`

          Suggested tolerance in basis points, to take off a preview's quote when you compute the floor. Your customer may choose another.

      - **`hostCluster`** · `string` · required · one of `devnet`, `mainnet-beta`

        The cluster the strategy runs on.

      - **`fundable`** · `boolean` · required

        Whether the strategy exists on your project's cluster. `false` means a deposit can never work from this project. `true` is necessary but not sufficient: the strategy must also be `active`, and your organization must be activated for the provider.

      - **`feeSponsored`** · `boolean` · required

        Whether SDP pays network fees for Treasury movements on this strategy from your environment. It never applies to a customer's wallet: to sponsor an Embedded Yield transaction, pass `feePayer` when you build it. Always `false` when the strategy is not `fundable`, and a swap-funded deposit is never sponsored.

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`updatedAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

    - **`total`** · `integer` · required · example `6`

      Total rows visible to the caller across all pages.

    - **`page`** · `integer` · required · example `1`

    - **`pageSize`** · `integer` · required · example `20`

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `earn.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`429`** Too Many Requests

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`503`** Service Unavailable

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"
curl 'https://api.solana.com/v1/earn/strategies' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const res = await fetch("https://api.solana.com/v1/earn/strategies", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`
  }
});
```

```python tab="Python"

  headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['SDP_API_KEY']}"})
```

### Preview a deposit
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/earn/create-earn-vault-deposit-preview

> Quotes how many shares a deposit would receive right now, from the provider's live accounting.

> **Earn is under active development.** Features, API endpoints, and docs may change.

`POST /v1/earn/vault-deposit-previews`

When the strategy's `depositSlippage` is not null, set `minSharesOut` from this quote: take your tolerance off `sharesOut`. Resolve every `blockingIssues` entry before you build. The preview is read-only, takes no Idempotency-Key, and applies a deposit's access checks, provider activation included. It returns 501 when the provider cannot quote deposits.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `earn.read` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Quote one direct vault deposit against the provider's live accounting. Read-only: nothing is built and nothing is persisted.

- **`strategyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `earn_strategy_3b6a81ce-00b0-4c5a-9761-cb359932e97e`

- **`amount`** · `string` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^(?=.*[1-9])\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25`

  Deposit amount in deposit-token units.

## Responses

- **`200`** Live deposit quote

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    - **`strategyId`** · `string` · required · example `earn_strategy_3b6a81ce-00b0-4c5a-9761-cb359932e97e`

    - **`sharesOut`** · `string` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^(?=.*[1-9])\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `24.98`

      Shares the deposit would mint at the live rate. Derive `minSharesOut` from this value minus the chosen tolerance, quantized to `shareDecimals`.

    - **`shareDecimals`** · `integer` · required · example `6`

      The share mint's decimals, which the floor must be quantized to.

    - **`blockingIssues`** · `object[]` · required

      Conditions the provider reports would block this deposit; empty when none.

      - **`code`** · `string` · required · example `SHARE_LOCKED`

      - **`message`** · `string` · required

    - **`feeSponsored`** · `boolean` · required

      Whether SDP pays network fees for Treasury movements on this cluster. It does not apply to customer wallets: to sponsor an Embedded Yield transaction, pass `feePayer` when you build it.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `earn.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`429`** Too Many Requests

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`501`** The provider does not support this operation.

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`503`** Service Unavailable

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"

  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "strategyId": "earn_strategy_3b6a81ce-00b0-4c5a-9761-cb359932e97e",
    "amount": "25"
  }'
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
  },

```

## Earn: Embedded Yield

### Get position totals
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/earn/get-earn-external-wallet-position-summary

> Gets live position totals across every customer wallet in your project, grouped by strategy and token.

> **Earn is under active development.** Features, API endpoints, and docs may change.

`GET /v1/earn/external-wallet/positions/summary`

Wallet addresses are left out unless you pass `includeOwnerAddresses=true`; add `includePositions=true` to also receive each wallet's positions, which saves one read per wallet. A total that depends on an unavailable live value is left out, never reported as zero or partial.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `earn.read` action.

## Query parameters

- **`includeOwnerAddresses`** · `string` · one of `true`, `false`

- **`includePositions`** · `string` · one of `true`, `false`

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Position totals

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    - **`summary`** · `object` · required

      - **`walletCount`** · `integer` · required · min 0

      - **`positionCount`** · `integer` · required · min 0

      - **`unavailablePositionCount`** · `integer` · required · min 0

      - **`totalsByStrategy`** · `object[]` · required

        - **`provider`** · `string` · required · example `kamino`

        - **`providerReference`** · `string` · required · example `7uib8xGAwkaPz4ZGCA6t8sSEid5Yp9ty13PHUweTypx`

        - **`label`** · `string` · required · example `Allez USDC`

        - **`ownerAddresses`** · `string[]` · each min length 32 · each max length 44 · each pattern `^[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{32,44}$` · each example `9WzDXwBbmkg8ZTbNMqUxvQRAyrZzDsGYdLVL9zYtAWWM`

          The customer wallets behind this total. Absent unless the request passes `includeOwnerAddresses=true`. The list is personal data about your customers, so opt in only where you show per-customer detail.

        - **`positions`** · `object[]`

          Complete live positions contributing to this strategy total. Present only when the request passes `includePositions=true` together with `includeOwnerAddresses=true`; use this single drill-down instead of one live request per owner.

          - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `earn_position_2f8b6b04-7147-487e-b760-b1caa4fbcb8b`

          - **`ownerAddress`** · `string` · required · example `9WzDXwBbmkg8ZTbNMqUxvQRAyrZzDsGYdLVL9zYtAWWM`

            The customer's wallet address.

          - **`provider`** · `string` · required · example `kamino`

          - **`providerReference`** · `string` · required · example `7uib8xGAwkaPz4ZGCA6t8sSEid5Yp9ty13PHUweTypx`

            The strategy's onchain address.

          - **`label`** · `string` · required · example `Allez USDC`

          - **`tokenMint`** · `string` · required · example `4zMMC9srt5Ri5X14GAgXhaHii3GnPAEERYPJgZJDncDU`

          - **`shareMint`** · `string` · required · example `hXm2xSRF5PLKGMrTvAWqKhR76MuJX5dAabeSChkjqu2`

          - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

            ISO 8601 timestamp.

          - **`closedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

            ISO 8601 timestamp.

          - **`shares`** · `string` · max length 128 · pattern `^\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25.42`

            Live share balance. Absent when the live read is unavailable; never zero-filled.

          - **`withdrawableShares`** · `string` · max length 128 · pattern `^\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25.42`

            Shares you can withdraw right now. Absent when the live read is unavailable.

          - **`unlockTimestamp`** · `string | null` · pattern `^\d+$` · example `1789722000`

            Unix time, in seconds, when locked shares become withdrawable. Null or absent when no lock applies. To tell an unavailable read apart, check `shares`.

          - **`tokenValue`** · `string` · max length 128 · pattern `^\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25.42`

            Live value of the position in the deposit token (`tokenMint`), as the provider reports it: shares times the rate for rate-based strategies, or a withdrawal quote for the whole position for quote-based providers such as Veda and Ondo. A quote already includes spread and price impact, so it does not scale to other share amounts. It is a deposit-token amount, not a share count or a USD conversion; every Earn deposit token is a USD stablecoin, so at par it reads as dollars. Absent when the live read is unavailable.

          - **`parIntermediate`** · `object`

            The operator redemption's intermediate token the wallet holds outside any open request, such as Hastra wYLDS after a canceled operator redemption. It belongs to this position and is not included in `tokenValue`. Present only while non-zero.

            - **`mint`** · `string` · required · example `8fr7WGTVFszfyNWRMXj6fRjZZAnDwmXwEpCrtzmUkdih`

            - **`amount`** · `string` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25.42`

              Live decimal value returned by the vault provider; never a float.

            - **`withdrawableAmount`** · `string` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25.42`

              Zero while the provider has frozen the token account.

            - **`tokenValue`** · `string` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25.42`

              Value in the position's deposit token (`tokenMint`).

        - **`walletCount`** · `integer` · required · min 0

        - **`positionCount`** · `integer` · required · min 0

        - **`totalsByToken`** · `object[]` · required

          - **`tokenMint`** · `string` · required · example `4zMMC9srt5Ri5X14GAgXhaHii3GnPAEERYPJgZJDncDU`

          - **`walletCount`** · `integer` · required · min 0

          - **`positionCount`** · `integer` · required · min 0

          - **`unavailablePositionCount`** · `integer` · required · min 0

          - **`tokenValue`** · `string` · max length 128 · pattern `^\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25.42`

            Exact live total in the deposit token (`tokenMint`): the sum of the positions' `tokenValue` plus any `parIntermediate.tokenValue`, a dollar figure at par. Absent when any contributing position is unavailable, so partial money is never presented as complete.

      - **`totalsByToken`** · `object[]` · required

        - **`tokenMint`** · `string` · required · example `4zMMC9srt5Ri5X14GAgXhaHii3GnPAEERYPJgZJDncDU`

        - **`walletCount`** · `integer` · required · min 0

        - **`positionCount`** · `integer` · required · min 0

        - **`unavailablePositionCount`** · `integer` · required · min 0

        - **`tokenValue`** · `string` · max length 128 · pattern `^\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25.42`

          Exact live total in the deposit token (`tokenMint`): the sum of the positions' `tokenValue` plus any `parIntermediate.tokenValue`, a dollar figure at par. Absent when any contributing position is unavailable, so partial money is never presented as complete.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `earn.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`429`** Too Many Requests

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`503`** Service Unavailable

  Same fields as `400`.

## Example request

```bash tab="cURL"

  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SDP_API_KEY"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"

  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SDP_API_KEY}`
  }

```

### List positions
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/earn/list-earn-external-wallet-positions

> Lists one customer wallet's live positions, one page at a time.

> **Earn is under active development.** Features, API endpoints, and docs may change.

`GET /v1/earn/external-wallet/positions`

`ownerAddress` is required. A wallet with no positions in your project (never deposited, fully withdrawn, or held under another organization) returns an empty `positions` list, not 404. Live fields are left out, never set to zero, when the provider read is unavailable.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `earn.read` action.

## Query parameters

- **`ownerAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · pattern `^[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{32,44}$` · example `9WzDXwBbmkg8ZTbNMqUxvQRAyrZzDsGYdLVL9zYtAWWM`

  The customer's wallet address: an external wallet, so SDP holds no key for it. It signs, owns the shares, and pays the network fee unless the build names a `feePayer`. It must decode to a 32-byte public key; a base58 string that matches the pattern but does not decode returns 400.

- **`limit`** · `integer` · min 1 · max 100 · default `20`

  Page size, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

- **`before`** · `string` · min length 1

  The previous page's `nextCursor`. Omit it for the first page.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** One page of positions

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    - **`ownerAddress`** · `string` · required · example `9WzDXwBbmkg8ZTbNMqUxvQRAyrZzDsGYdLVL9zYtAWWM`

      The customer's wallet address.

    - **`positions`** · `object[]` · required

      - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `earn_position_2f8b6b04-7147-487e-b760-b1caa4fbcb8b`

      - **`ownerAddress`** · `string` · required · example `9WzDXwBbmkg8ZTbNMqUxvQRAyrZzDsGYdLVL9zYtAWWM`

        The customer's wallet address.

      - **`provider`** · `string` · required · example `kamino`

      - **`providerReference`** · `string` · required · example `7uib8xGAwkaPz4ZGCA6t8sSEid5Yp9ty13PHUweTypx`

        The strategy's onchain address.

      - **`label`** · `string` · required · example `Allez USDC`

      - **`tokenMint`** · `string` · required · example `4zMMC9srt5Ri5X14GAgXhaHii3GnPAEERYPJgZJDncDU`

      - **`shareMint`** · `string` · required · example `hXm2xSRF5PLKGMrTvAWqKhR76MuJX5dAabeSChkjqu2`

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`closedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`shares`** · `string` · max length 128 · pattern `^\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25.42`

        Live share balance. Absent when the live read is unavailable; never zero-filled.

      - **`withdrawableShares`** · `string` · max length 128 · pattern `^\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25.42`

        Shares you can withdraw right now. Absent when the live read is unavailable.

      - **`unlockTimestamp`** · `string | null` · pattern `^\d+$` · example `1789722000`

        Unix time, in seconds, when locked shares become withdrawable. Null or absent when no lock applies. To tell an unavailable read apart, check `shares`.

      - **`tokenValue`** · `string` · max length 128 · pattern `^\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25.42`

        Live value of the position in the deposit token (`tokenMint`), as the provider reports it: shares times the rate for rate-based strategies, or a withdrawal quote for the whole position for quote-based providers such as Veda and Ondo. A quote already includes spread and price impact, so it does not scale to other share amounts. It is a deposit-token amount, not a share count or a USD conversion; every Earn deposit token is a USD stablecoin, so at par it reads as dollars. Absent when the live read is unavailable.

      - **`parIntermediate`** · `object`

        The operator redemption's intermediate token the wallet holds outside any open request, such as Hastra wYLDS after a canceled operator redemption. It belongs to this position and is not included in `tokenValue`. Present only while non-zero.

        - **`mint`** · `string` · required · example `8fr7WGTVFszfyNWRMXj6fRjZZAnDwmXwEpCrtzmUkdih`

        - **`amount`** · `string` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25.42`

          Live decimal value returned by the vault provider; never a float.

        - **`withdrawableAmount`** · `string` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25.42`

          Zero while the provider has frozen the token account.

        - **`tokenValue`** · `string` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25.42`

          Value in the position's deposit token (`tokenMint`).

    - **`hasMore`** · `boolean` · required

    - **`nextCursor`** · `string | null` · required

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

### List movements
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/earn/list-earn-external-wallet-movements

> Lists one customer wallet's deposits and withdrawals, newest first, one page at a time.

> **Earn is under active development.** Features, API endpoints, and docs may change.

`GET /v1/earn/external-wallet/movements`

Movement statuses are `requested`, `submitted`, `confirmed`, `finalized` and `failed`; only `finalized` and `failed` are final. `ownerAddress` is required, and a wallet with no movements returns an empty `movements` list, not 404. Show `tokenAmount` in `tokenMint` units: on a withdrawal it is the observed payout once finalized, while `amount` and `denomination` carry the onchain quantity, which is shares. Reads keep working after a provider stops taking deposits.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `earn.read` action.

## Query parameters

- **`ownerAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · pattern `^[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{32,44}$` · example `9WzDXwBbmkg8ZTbNMqUxvQRAyrZzDsGYdLVL9zYtAWWM`

  The customer's wallet address: an external wallet, so SDP holds no key for it. It signs, owns the shares, and pays the network fee unless the build names a `feePayer`. It must decode to a 32-byte public key; a base58 string that matches the pattern but does not decode returns 400.

- **`direction`** · `string` · one of `deposit`, `withdrawal`

- **`status`** · `string` · min length 1 · max length 64

  Return only movements in this status, such as `finalized`. Takes one value; an unknown value matches nothing.

- **`limit`** · `integer` · min 1 · max 100 · default `20`

  Page size, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

- **`before`** · `string` · min length 1

  The previous page's `nextCursor`. Omit it for the first page.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** One page of movements

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    - **`ownerAddress`** · `string` · required · example `9WzDXwBbmkg8ZTbNMqUxvQRAyrZzDsGYdLVL9zYtAWWM`

      The customer's wallet address.

    - **`movements`** · `object[]` · required

      The wallet's recorded movements, newest first.

      - **`settlementOutcome`** · `string` · one of `delivered`, `cancelled`

      - **`movementId`** · `string` · required · example `earn_movement_a6aed3f5-4f89-4dc6-9d4b-0864021bd80d`

      - **`positionId`** · `string` · required · example `earn_position_2f8b6b04-7147-487e-b760-b1caa4fbcb8b`

      - **`provider`** · `string` · required · example `kamino`

      - **`providerReference`** · `string` · required · example `7uib8xGAwkaPz4ZGCA6t8sSEid5Yp9ty13PHUweTypx`

      - **`direction`** · `string` · required · one of `deposit`, `withdrawal`

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `requested`, `submitted`, `confirmed`, `finalized`, `failed`

        The movement's status. `requested` means SDP recorded the signed transaction but has not yet seen it on the network. `confirmed` is optimistic and can still be rolled back; only `finalized` and `failed` are final.

      - **`settlement`** · `string` · required · one of `atomic`, `provider_order`

        How the movement settles. `atomic` completes in one transaction, so you may show it as done at `confirmed` while SDP tracks finality. `provider_order` pays out later through the provider, so chain confirmation alone is not payout: the movement stays `confirmed` until the provider completes it, and only `finalized` means it is done.

      - **`signature`** · `string` · required

        The transaction signature, for explorers.

      - **`ownerAddress`** · `string` · required · example `9WzDXwBbmkg8ZTbNMqUxvQRAyrZzDsGYdLVL9zYtAWWM`

        The customer's wallet address.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^(?=.*[1-9])\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25`

        Requested quantity, denominated in `denomination`.

      - **`denomination`** · `string` · required · example `4zMMC9srt5Ri5X14GAgXhaHii3GnPAEERYPJgZJDncDU`

        Token mint for a deposit; share mint for a withdrawal.

      - **`tokenMint`** · `string` · required · example `4zMMC9srt5Ri5X14GAgXhaHii3GnPAEERYPJgZJDncDU`

        The position's deposit-token mint. Show `tokenAmount` in these units; `amount` and `denomination` carry the onchain quantity, which is shares on a withdrawal.

      - **`tokenAmount`** · `string | null` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^(?=.*[1-9])\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25`

        Quantity in `tokenMint` units. Kamino deposits and all withdrawals require a finalized observation; null beforehand or when the actual debit/payout cannot be observed. Other deposits report their fixed input amount.

      - **`failureReason`** · `string | null` · required

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`confirmedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`settledAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`replayed`** · `boolean`

        True when the idempotency key already produced this movement and nothing was re-sent.

    - **`hasMore`** · `boolean` · required

    - **`nextCursor`** · `string | null` · required

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `earn.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`429`** Too Many Requests

  Same fields as `400`.

### Get a movement
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/earn/get-earn-external-wallet-movement

> Gets one deposit or withdrawal and refreshes its onchain status when it can.

> **Earn is under active development.** Features, API endpoints, and docs may change.

`GET /v1/earn/external-wallet/movements/{movementId}`

Use it to track a movement after submit, or to recover a submit whose response was lost. If the chain read fails, you get the last recorded status while SDP keeps reconciling in the background. An atomic movement can show as done at `confirmed`, but only `finalized` and `failed` are final. For `settlement: provider_order`, chain confirmation is not payout: the provider still has to complete the order.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `earn.read` action.

## Path parameters

- **`movementId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · max length 128 · example `earn_movement_a6aed3f5-4f89-4dc6-9d4b-0864021bd80d`

  The `movementId` a submit returned.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Recorded movement

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    - **`movement`** · `object` · required

      One recorded external-wallet vault movement.

      - **`settlementOutcome`** · `string` · one of `delivered`, `cancelled`

      - **`provider`** · `string` · required · example `kamino`

      - **`providerReference`** · `string` · required · example `7uib8xGAwkaPz4ZGCA6t8sSEid5Yp9ty13PHUweTypx`

### Get earnings
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/earn/get-earn-external-wallet-earnings

> Gets one customer wallet's live balance and earnings per deposit token.

> **Earn is under active development.** Features, API endpoints, and docs may change.

`GET /v1/earn/external-wallet/earnings`

`earned` is live value plus observed withdrawal payouts (`totalWithdrawn`) minus finalized deposits (`totalDeposited`), and appears only when it is exact. Otherwise it is left out with an `earnedUnavailableReason`, such as a live value that is unavailable, movements that are still settling, or a withdrawal payout SDP did not observe; never show it as zero. A wallet with no positions returns `positionCount: 0` and an empty `totalsByToken`, not 404. Totals cover the positions the wallet holds now: a fully withdrawn position drops out here but stays in the movements list. Live value reads the wallet's whole balance in the strategy, so shares acquired outside SDP raise it.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `earn.read` action.

## Query parameters

- **`ownerAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · pattern `^[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{32,44}$` · example `9WzDXwBbmkg8ZTbNMqUxvQRAyrZzDsGYdLVL9zYtAWWM`

  The customer's wallet address: an external wallet, so SDP holds no key for it. It signs, owns the shares, and pays the network fee unless the build names a `feePayer`. It must decode to a 32-byte public key; a base58 string that matches the pattern but does not decode returns 400.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Responses

- **`200`** Earnings per deposit token

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    - **`earnings`** · `object` · required

      - **`ownerAddress`** · `string` · required · example `9WzDXwBbmkg8ZTbNMqUxvQRAyrZzDsGYdLVL9zYtAWWM`

        The customer's wallet address.

      - **`positionCount`** · `integer` · required · min 0

      - **`unavailablePositionCount`** · `integer` · required · min 0

      - **`totalsByToken`** · `object[]` · required

        - **`tokenMint`** · `string` · required · example `4zMMC9srt5Ri5X14GAgXhaHii3GnPAEERYPJgZJDncDU`

        - **`positionCount`** · `integer` · required · min 0

        - **`unavailablePositionCount`** · `integer` · required · min 0

          Positions whose live value could not be read.

        - **`currentValue`** · `string` · max length 128 · pattern `^\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25.42`

          Live value across the token's positions, including any par intermediate they hold. Absent when any contributing position is unavailable, so partial money is never presented as complete.

        - **`totalDeposited`** · `string` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25.42`

          Sum of observed finalized SDP deposits. Excludes unobserved receipts (see `deposits_not_valued`).

        - **`totalWithdrawn`** · `string` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25.42`

          Sum of the observed payouts of finalized withdrawals. Always present. Excludes withdrawals whose payout SDP did not observe (see `withdrawals_not_valued`).

        - **`earned`** · `string` · max length 129 · pattern `^-?\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `5.2`

          `currentValue + totalWithdrawn - totalDeposited`, present only when exact and never zero-filled. The live value reads the wallet's whole balance in the strategy, so shares acquired outside SDP raise this figure.

        - **`earnedUnavailableReason`** · `string` · one of `live_value_unavailable`, `movements_pending`, `withdrawals_pending`, `deposits_not_valued`, `withdrawals_not_valued`

          Why `earned` is absent: `live_value_unavailable` (a live value could not be read), `movements_pending` (a movement is still settling), `withdrawals_pending` (a held position has an open withdrawal request, whose shares leave the wallet before its payout, which can take days), or `deposits_not_valued` and `withdrawals_not_valued` (SDP did not observe a finalized deposit or withdrawal, so `totalDeposited` or `totalWithdrawn` is incomplete).

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `earn.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`429`** Too Many Requests

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`503`** Service Unavailable

  Same fields as `400`.

### Build a deposit transaction
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/earn/create-earn-external-wallet-deposit-transaction

> Builds an unsigned deposit transaction for the customer's wallet to sign.

> **Earn is under active development.** Features, API endpoints, and docs may change.

`POST /v1/earn/external-wallet/deposit-transactions`

Nothing moves until you submit the signed transaction. The build applies provider access checks and can name your own `feePayer`, which then signs alongside the customer. A swap-funded deposit that cannot fit in one transaction returns a separate swap and follow-up deposit instead of `transaction`, so check the response before you request a signature.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `earn.execute` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Build one unsigned deposit transaction for an external wallet.

- **`strategyId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `earn_strategy_3b6a81ce-00b0-4c5a-9761-cb359932e97e`

- **`ownerAddress`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · pattern `^[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{32,44}$` · example `9WzDXwBbmkg8ZTbNMqUxvQRAyrZzDsGYdLVL9zYtAWWM`

  The customer's wallet address: an external wallet, so SDP holds no key for it. It signs, owns the shares, and pays the network fee unless the build names a `feePayer`. It must decode to a 32-byte public key; a base58 string that matches the pattern but does not decode returns 400.

- **`feePayer`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · pattern `^[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{32,44}$` · example `3nMFwZXwY1s1M5s8vYAHqd4wGs4iSxXE4LRoUMMYqEgF`

  Pay for this transaction from a wallet your backend controls instead of the customer's. The named address becomes the fee payer: it pays the network fee, funds any share-account rent, and must sign alongside the customer. Co-sign on your backend before you submit. The build returns 400, naming the fee payer, when it cannot pay. Sending the customer's own address keeps the default: the customer pays and signs alone.

- **`amount`** · `string` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^(?=.*[1-9])\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25`

  The deposit amount as a decimal string, in deposit-token units. For a swap-funded build (`sourceTokenMint`), it is in source-token units instead: the swap spends all of it, and the deposit is sized to the swap's guaranteed output.

- **`minSharesOut`** · `string` · max length 128 · pattern `^(?=.*[1-9])\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `24.9`

  Slippage floor in share units. Required exactly when the selected strategy's `depositSlippage` is non-null. Derive it from `POST /v1/earn/vault-deposit-previews`, never from the deposit amount.

- **`sourceTokenMint`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · pattern `^[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{32,44}$` · example `2b1kV6DkPAnxd5ixfnxCpjxmKwqjjaYmCZfHsFu24GXo`

  Fund the deposit in a different supported stablecoin (USDC, USDG, PYUSD or USDT on the environment's cluster): a Jupiter swap to the vault's own token is prepended inside the same transaction, so both legs land atomically or not at all. Equal to the strategy's deposit mint it is a no-op, so pickers may always send their selection.

- **`swapSlippageBps`** · `integer` · min 1 · max 500 · example `2`

  Swap slippage tolerance in basis points (default 2, accepted 1-500). Valid only with `sourceTokenMint`. The deposit is sized to the swap's worst-case output, so a wider tolerance can leave more of the deposit token in the customer's account instead of failing the transaction.

## Responses

- **`200`** Unsigned deposit transaction

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    Any of:

    - **object**

      - **`transaction`** · `object` · required

        The built deposit transaction plus the strategy it targets.

        - **`transactionId`** · `string` · required · example `earn_external_wallet_transaction_e7a88258-1d19-48f3-8d0e-81fefa4bf3b3`

        - **`transaction`** · `string` · required

          Base64 wire bytes of the unsigned transaction. Add every required signature without changing the message, then submit through SDP. The blockhash bounds when the network can first accept it; retain the original signed bytes for recovery.

        - **`lastValidBlockHeight`** · `string` · required · example `361186610`

          Last block height at which the network can first accept this transaction. This is a block height, not a slot or timestamp.

        - **`sponsored`** · `boolean` · required · example `false`

          Always false: SDP does not pay an external wallet's fees. The customer's wallet pays, or the `feePayer` you name.

        - **`ownerAddress`** · `string` · required · example `9WzDXwBbmkg8ZTbNMqUxvQRAyrZzDsGYdLVL9zYtAWWM`

          The customer's wallet address.

        - **`feePayer`** · `string` · example `3nMFwZXwY1s1M5s8vYAHqd4wGs4iSxXE4LRoUMMYqEgF`

          The `feePayer` your build request named. When present, the transaction needs the fee payer's signature as well as the customer's: co-sign on your backend before you submit, or the submit refuses it. When omitted, the customer signs alone and pays the fee.

        - **`provider`** · `string` · required · example `kamino`

        - **`providerReference`** · `string` · required · example `7uib8xGAwkaPz4ZGCA6t8sSEid5Yp9ty13PHUweTypx`

          The strategy's onchain address at the provider. It identifies the instrument; never send funds to it.

        - **`tokenMint`** · `string` · required · example `4zMMC9srt5Ri5X14GAgXhaHii3GnPAEERYPJgZJDncDU`

        - **`shareMint`** · `string` · required · example `hXm2xSRF5PLKGMrTvAWqKhR76MuJX5dAabeSChkjqu2`

        - **`amount`** · `string` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^(?=.*[1-9])\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25`

          Positive decimal string with at least one non-zero digit; never a float.

        - **`minSharesOut`** · `string | null` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^(?=.*[1-9])\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25`

          Positive decimal string with at least one non-zero digit; never a float.

        - **`swap`** · `object`

          Present when the build was swap-funded: the swap is prepended inside this same transaction and `amount` equals `swap.depositAmount`.

          - **`sourceTokenMint`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · pattern `^[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{32,44}$` · example `2b1kV6DkPAnxd5ixfnxCpjxmKwqjjaYmCZfHsFu24GXo`

            Mint the owner pays with.

          - **`sourceAmount`** · `string` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^(?=.*[1-9])\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25`

            What the swap spends, in source-token units.

          - **`depositAmount`** · `string` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^(?=.*[1-9])\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25`

            The deposit amount the transaction encodes, in deposit-token units: the swap's guaranteed minimum output. Any output above it stays in the customer's token account.

          - **`quotedAmount`** · `string` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^(?=.*[1-9])\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25`

            The swap's quoted output at the live rate, in deposit-token units.

          - **`slippageBps`** · `integer` · required · example `2`

          - **`priceImpactPct`** · `string` · required · example `0.0001`

            Quoted price impact as a decimal ratio string.

          - **`routeLabels`** · `string[]` · required

            Venue labels along the quoted route.

        - **`strategy`** · `object` · required

          - **`id`** · `string` · required · example `earn_strategy_3b6a81ce-00b0-4c5a-9761-cb359932e97e`

          - **`name`** · `string` · required · example `Allez USDC`

          - **`provider`** · `string` · required · example `kamino`

          - **`providerReference`** · `string` · required · example `7uib8xGAwkaPz4ZGCA6t8sSEid5Yp9ty13PHUweTypx`

          - **`hostCluster`** · `string` · required · example `devnet`

    - **Returned instead of a built transaction when the swap and the deposit cannot fit in one Solana transaction (1,232 bytes), even on a compact route. SDP saves no build or movement for it.**

      - **`requiresSeparateSwap`** · `boolean` · required · always `true`

        Discriminates from the atomic answer, which carries `transaction`.

      - **`sponsored`** · `boolean` · required · always `false`

        Split swap transactions are never sponsored by SDP.

      - **`swap`** · `object` · required

        The Jupiter swap leg attached to (or split out of) a swap-funded deposit.

        - **`sourceTokenMint`** · `string` · required · min length 32 · max length 44 · pattern `^[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{32,44}$` · example `2b1kV6DkPAnxd5ixfnxCpjxmKwqjjaYmCZfHsFu24GXo`

          Mint the owner pays with.

        - **`sourceAmount`** · `string` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^(?=.*[1-9])\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25`

          What the swap spends, in source-token units.

        - **`depositAmount`** · `string` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^(?=.*[1-9])\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25`

          The deposit amount the transaction encodes, in deposit-token units: the swap's guaranteed minimum output. Any output above it stays in the customer's token account.

        - **`quotedAmount`** · `string` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^(?=.*[1-9])\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25`

          The swap's quoted output at the live rate, in deposit-token units.

        - **`slippageBps`** · `integer` · required · example `2`

        - **`priceImpactPct`** · `string` · required · example `0.0001`

          Quoted price impact as a decimal ratio string.

        - **`routeLabels`** · `string[]` · required

          Venue labels along the quoted route.

        - **`transaction`** · `string` · required

          Base64 wire bytes of the unsigned swap-only transaction. The fee payer is the customer, or your request's `feePayer`, which then co-signs it too. You broadcast it yourself: it moves only the customer's own funds, so SDP records nothing for it.

        - **`lastValidBlockHeight`** · `string` · required · example `361186610`

      - **`followUp`** · `object` · required

        The ordinary (unswapped) deposit build to request once the swap is confirmed.

        - **`strategyId`** · `string` · required · example `earn_strategy_3b6a81ce-00b0-4c5a-9761-cb359932e97e`

        - **`amount`** · `string` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^(?=.*[1-9])\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25`

          Positive decimal string with at least one non-zero digit; never a float.

        - **`minSharesOut`** · `string` · max length 128 · pattern `^(?=.*[1-9])\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25`

          The original request's share floor, carried through so the follow-up build keeps the protection the caller asked for. Absent only when the original request carried none.

        - **`feePayer`** · `string` · example `3nMFwZXwY1s1M5s8vYAHqd4wGs4iSxXE4LRoUMMYqEgF`

          The original request's fee payer, carried through so the follow-up build does not silently bill the customer's wallet. Absent when none was named.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `earn.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`429`** Too Many Requests

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`501`** The provider does not support this operation.

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

### Submit a deposit
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/earn/create-earn-external-wallet-deposit

> Submits a deposit transaction signed by the customer's wallet.

> **Earn is under active development.** Features, API endpoints, and docs may change.

`POST /v1/earn/external-wallet/deposits`

SDP checks that the signed bytes match the built transaction and that every required signature is valid (the customer's, plus your fee payer's when the build named one), records the movement, then broadcasts. Idempotency-Key is required: a retry with the same key returns the original movement with `replayed: true`, and each built transaction can be submitted once. Reusing a key with a different body, or submitting one build under a second key, returns `409 CONFLICT`. Submit the original signed bytes even after the blockhash expires, since the wallet may already have broadcast them. After an uncertain response, retry with the same key and body, then read the movement; never replace a signed transaction whose outcome is unknown.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `earn.execute` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

- **`Idempotency-Key`** · `string` · required · pattern `^[\x20-\x7e]{1,255}$` · example `idempotency_example_12345`

  Idempotency key for safely retrying mutating requests. 1-255 printable ASCII characters; echoed back on the response.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Submit the signed bytes back. Requires the Idempotency-Key header; a retry with the same key resolves the original movement or withdrawal request instead of acting twice.

- **`transactionId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · max length 128 · example `earn_external_wallet_transaction_e7a88258-1d19-48f3-8d0e-81fefa4bf3b3`

  The built transaction being submitted; single-use.

- **`signedTransaction`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · max length 1700 · pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$` · example `AUyx/sEc49/1l6jxo3nbViPAIUqdrXCo8Qx5SfDvIbtUI0zex3Bi6Cyhhn1QTVU8zWDzXTRyIX2aCmq9v7yk5AOAAQABAvSV602SJ67iQCUGLwHzVtPnlMbZqL79wnV/nb+Mi9SJBUpTWpkpIQZNJOhxYNo4fHw1td28kruB5B+oQEEFRI0AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAEBAAtzZHAtZXhhbXBsZQA=`

  Base64 wire bytes of the signed transaction. They must be byte-for-byte the built message with only signatures added.

## Responses

- **`200`** The recorded deposit

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    - **`deposit`** · `object` · required

      One recorded external-wallet vault movement.

      - **`settlementOutcome`** · `string` · one of `delivered`, `cancelled`

      - **`movementId`** · `string` · required · example `earn_movement_a6aed3f5-4f89-4dc6-9d4b-0864021bd80d`

      - **`positionId`** · `string` · required · example `earn_position_2f8b6b04-7147-487e-b760-b1caa4fbcb8b`

      - **`provider`** · `string` · required · example `kamino`

      - **`providerReference`** · `string` · required · example `7uib8xGAwkaPz4ZGCA6t8sSEid5Yp9ty13PHUweTypx`

      - **`direction`** · `string` · required · one of `deposit`, `withdrawal`

      - **`status`** · `string` · required · one of `requested`, `submitted`, `confirmed`, `finalized`, `failed`

        The movement's status. `requested` means SDP recorded the signed transaction but has not yet seen it on the network. `confirmed` is optimistic and can still be rolled back; only `finalized` and `failed` are final.

      - **`settlement`** · `string` · required · one of `atomic`, `provider_order`

        How the movement settles. `atomic` completes in one transaction, so you may show it as done at `confirmed` while SDP tracks finality. `provider_order` pays out later through the provider, so chain confirmation alone is not payout: the movement stays `confirmed` until the provider completes it, and only `finalized` means it is done.

      - **`signature`** · `string` · required

        The transaction signature, for explorers.

      - **`ownerAddress`** · `string` · required · example `9WzDXwBbmkg8ZTbNMqUxvQRAyrZzDsGYdLVL9zYtAWWM`

        The customer's wallet address.

      - **`amount`** · `string` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^(?=.*[1-9])\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25`

        Requested quantity, denominated in `denomination`.

      - **`denomination`** · `string` · required · example `4zMMC9srt5Ri5X14GAgXhaHii3GnPAEERYPJgZJDncDU`

        Token mint for a deposit; share mint for a withdrawal.

      - **`tokenMint`** · `string` · required · example `4zMMC9srt5Ri5X14GAgXhaHii3GnPAEERYPJgZJDncDU`

        The position's deposit-token mint. Show `tokenAmount` in these units; `amount` and `denomination` carry the onchain quantity, which is shares on a withdrawal.

      - **`tokenAmount`** · `string | null` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^(?=.*[1-9])\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25`

        Quantity in `tokenMint` units. Kamino deposits and all withdrawals require a finalized observation; null beforehand or when the actual debit/payout cannot be observed. Other deposits report their fixed input amount.

      - **`failureReason`** · `string | null` · required

      - **`createdAt`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`confirmedAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`settledAt`** · `string | null` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

        ISO 8601 timestamp.

      - **`replayed`** · `boolean`

        True when the idempotency key already produced this movement and nothing was re-sent.

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `earn.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`409`** Conflict

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`429`** Too Many Requests

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`503`** Service Unavailable

  Same fields as `400`.

### Preview a withdrawal
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/earn/create-earn-external-wallet-withdrawal-preview

> Quotes what withdrawing these shares would pay right now, from the strategy's live accounting.

> **Earn is under active development.** Features, API endpoints, and docs may change.

`POST /v1/earn/external-wallet/withdrawal-previews`

When the strategy's `withdrawalSlippage` is not null, set `minAmountOut` from this quote: take your tolerance off `assetsOut`, rounded down to `assetDecimals`. The preview is read-only, takes no Idempotency-Key, and still works after a strategy is deprecated or its provider stops taking deposits. It does not check the wallet's balance, so keep `shares` within the position's `withdrawableShares`. It returns 501 when the provider cannot quote withdrawals.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `earn.read` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Quote one withdrawal from a position against the strategy's live accounting. Read-only: nothing is built or saved.

- **`positionId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · max length 128 · example `earn_position_2f8b6b04-7147-487e-b760-b1caa4fbcb8b`

  The position's ID, from the positions list or the deposit submit response.

- **`shares`** · `string` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^(?=.*[1-9])\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `10`

  Shares to withdraw, as a decimal string in share units. Keep it within the position's `withdrawableShares`: the preview does not check the balance.

## Responses

- **`200`** Live withdrawal quote

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    - **`positionId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · max length 128 · example `earn_position_2f8b6b04-7147-487e-b760-b1caa4fbcb8b`

      The position's ID, from the positions list or the deposit submit response.

    - **`assetsOut`** · `string` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^(?=.*[1-9])\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25.02`

      What redeeming the shares would pay at the live rate, decimal string in the deposit token's units. A truthful `minAmountOut` floor is derived from this figure.

    - **`assetDecimals`** · `integer` · required · example `6`

      The deposit token's decimals, which define the scale used to quantize a floor.

    - **`blockingIssues`** · `object[]` · required

      Conditions the provider reports would block this withdrawal; empty when none.

      - **`code`** · `string` · required · example `SHARE_LOCKED`

      - **`message`** · `string` · required

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `earn.read` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`429`** Too Many Requests

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`501`** The provider does not support this operation.

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`503`** Service Unavailable

  Same fields as `400`.

### Build a withdrawal transaction
Source: https://platform.solana.com/docs/reference/api/earn/create-earn-external-wallet-withdrawal-transaction

> Builds an unsigned withdrawal transaction for a position, for the customer's wallet to sign.

> **Earn is under active development.** Features, API endpoints, and docs may change.

`POST /v1/earn/external-wallet/withdrawal-transactions`

Withdrawals keep working after a provider stops taking deposits. Send `minAmountOut` when the strategy's `withdrawalSlippage` is not null, and omit it when null. A provider-order route may not support a preview: it places an order that pays out later, not an instant redemption.

Requires an [API key](/docs/developing-with-sdp/authentication) with the `earn.execute` action.

## Headers

- **`x-project-id`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `prj_example`

  Required for dashboard sessions. API keys use their assigned project.

## Request body

`application/json` · required

Build one unsigned withdrawal transaction for a position. SDP reads the strategy and mints from the position.

- **`positionId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · max length 128 · example `earn_position_2f8b6b04-7147-487e-b760-b1caa4fbcb8b`

  The position's ID, from the positions list or the deposit submit response.

- **`redemptionMode`** · `string` · one of `standard`, `instant`

  The redemption route to build: `standard` queues a provider-managed order for a later payout, `instant` is the provider's faster route but still waits for cross-chain delivery — chain confirmation alone is not payout, so treat the exit as complete only at the movement's verified `delivered` outcome. Defaults to `standard`; a provider without the requested route refuses the build.

- **`shares`** · `string` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^(?=.*[1-9])\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `10`

  Shares to redeem, decimal string in share units.

- **`minAmountOut`** · `string` · max length 128 · pattern `^(?=.*[1-9])\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `19.98`

  Withdrawal slippage floor: the minimum deposit-token amount to accept, as a decimal string. Derive it from the withdrawal preview's `assetsOut` minus your tolerance. Required when the strategy's `withdrawalSlippage` is not null; refused with 400 when it is null, because the transaction cannot enforce it.

- **`feePayer`** · `string` · min length 32 · max length 44 · pattern `^[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{32,44}$` · example `3nMFwZXwY1s1M5s8vYAHqd4wGs4iSxXE4LRoUMMYqEgF`

  Pay for this transaction from a wallet your backend controls instead of the customer's. The named address becomes the fee payer: it pays the network fee, funds any share-account rent, and must sign alongside the customer. Co-sign on your backend before you submit. The build returns 400, naming the fee payer, when it cannot pay. Sending the customer's own address keeps the default: the customer pays and signs alone.

## Responses

- **`200`** Unsigned withdrawal transaction

  - **`data`** · `object` · required

    - **`transaction`** · `object` · required

      The common fields of one built withdrawal transaction.

      - **`transactionId`** · `string` · required · example `earn_external_wallet_transaction_e7a88258-1d19-48f3-8d0e-81fefa4bf3b3`

      - **`transaction`** · `string` · required

        Base64 wire bytes of the unsigned transaction. Add every required signature without changing the message, then submit through SDP. The blockhash bounds when the network can first accept it; retain the original signed bytes for recovery.

      - **`lastValidBlockHeight`** · `string` · required · example `361186610`

        Last block height at which the network can first accept this transaction. This is a block height, not a slot or timestamp.

      - **`sponsored`** · `boolean` · required · example `false`

        Always false: SDP does not pay an external wallet's fees. The customer's wallet pays, or the `feePayer` you name.

      - **`ownerAddress`** · `string` · required · example `9WzDXwBbmkg8ZTbNMqUxvQRAyrZzDsGYdLVL9zYtAWWM`

        The customer's wallet address.

      - **`feePayer`** · `string` · example `3nMFwZXwY1s1M5s8vYAHqd4wGs4iSxXE4LRoUMMYqEgF`

        The `feePayer` your build request named. When present, the transaction needs the fee payer's signature as well as the customer's: co-sign on your backend before you submit, or the submit refuses it. When omitted, the customer signs alone and pays the fee.

      - **`provider`** · `string` · required · example `kamino`

      - **`providerReference`** · `string` · required · example `7uib8xGAwkaPz4ZGCA6t8sSEid5Yp9ty13PHUweTypx`

        The strategy's onchain address at the provider. It identifies the instrument; never send funds to it.

      - **`tokenMint`** · `string` · required · example `4zMMC9srt5Ri5X14GAgXhaHii3GnPAEERYPJgZJDncDU`

      - **`shareMint`** · `string` · required · example `hXm2xSRF5PLKGMrTvAWqKhR76MuJX5dAabeSChkjqu2`

      - **`shares`** · `string` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^(?=.*[1-9])\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25`

        Positive decimal string with at least one non-zero digit; never a float.

      - **`minAmountOut`** · `string | null` · required · max length 128 · pattern `^(?=.*[1-9])\d+(\.\d+)?$` · example `25`

        The floor encoded in the transaction, or null when the request carried none.

      - **`positionId`** · `string` · required · example `earn_position_2f8b6b04-7147-487e-b760-b1caa4fbcb8b`

  - **`meta`** · `object` · required

    Response metadata.

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · required · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

    - **`timestamp`** · `string` · required · format `date-time` · example `2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`

      ISO 8601 timestamp.

- **`400`** Bad Request

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

      Machine-readable error code.

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`

    - **`requestId`** · `string` · min length 1 · example `req_example`

      Request identifier for tracing.

- **`401`** Unauthorized

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`403`** Forbidden. Requires the `earn.execute` action: an API key must hold it (a module's `manage` or `execute` also covers its `read`), and a signed-in member's organization role must include it. Without it the error is INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS and `error.details.action` names the action. Any other 403 names its own reason.

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`404`** Not Found

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`429`** Too Many Requests

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`500`** Internal Server Error

  Same fields as `400`.

- **`501`** The provider does not support this operation.

  - **`error`** · `object` · required

    Standard error payload.

    - **`code`** · `string` · required

    - **`message`** · `string` · required

      Human-readable error message.

    - **`details`** · `object`

      Optional error details for debugging.

      - **`*`** · `any`

  - **`meta`** · `object`
